9.s:
rākṣasīrakṣitāṃ sītāṃ bhava bhāryeti vādinaṃ /
rāvaṇaṃ śiṃśapāstho 'tha neti sītāntu vādinīṃ //
9.d:
राक्षसीरक्षितां सीतां भव भार्येति वादिनं /
रावणं शिंशपास्थो ऽथ नेति सीतान्तु वादिनीं //
9.m: Sītā guarded by rākṣasīs, and Rāvaṇa saying: "Become my wife!", / while he stood in the śiṃśapā tree, and Sītā saying: "No!"

9.s:
bhava bhāryā rāvaṇasya rākṣasīrvādinīḥ kapiḥ /
gate tu rāvaṇe prāha rājā daśaratho 'bhavat //
9.d:
भव भार्या रावणस्य राक्षसीर्वादिनीः कपिः /
गते तु रावणे प्राह राजा दशरथो ऽभवत् //
9.m:
And the rākṣasīs saying: "Become the wife of Rāvaṇa!"
When Rāvaṇa had departed, the monkey said: "There was a king Daśaratha.

9.s:
rāmo 'sya(1) lakṣmaṇaḥ putrau vanavāsaṅgatau varau /
rāmapatnī jānakī tvaṃ rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt //
9.d:
रामो ऽस्य(1) लक्ष्मणः पुत्रौ वनवासङ्गतौ वरौ /
रामपत्नी जानकी त्वं रावणेन हृता बलात् //
9.m: His excellent sons are Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa, who went to live in the forest. / You are Rāma's wife, Jānakī, carried off by Rāvaṇa by force.

9.s:
rāmaḥ sugrīvamitras tvāṃ mārgayan preṣayacca mām(2) /
sābhijñānañcāgulīyaṃ rāmadattaṃ gṛhāṇa vai //
9.d:
रामः सुग्रीवमित्रस् त्वां मार्गयन् प्रेषयच्च माम्(2) /
साभिज्ञानञ्चागुलीयं रामदत्तं गृहाण वै //
9.m: Rāma, allied with Sugrīva, searching for you, dispatched me. / Take indeed this token ring given by Rāma."

9.s:
sītāṅgulīyaṃ jagrāha sāpaśyanmārūtintarau /
bhūyo 'gre copaviṣṭaṃ tam uvāca yadi jīvati //
9.d:
सीताङ्गुलीयं जग्राह सापश्यन्मारूतिन्तरौ /
भूयो ऽग्रे चोपविष्टं तम् उवाच यदि जीवति //
9.m: Sītā took the ring. She saw the son of Marut in the tree. / Sitting once again before her, he said to her: "If he lives,

9.s:
rāmaḥ kathaṃ na nayati śṛṅkitāmabravīt kapiḥ /
rāmaḥ sīte na jānīte jñātvā tvāṃ sa nayiṣyati //
9.d:
रामः कथं न नयति शृङ्कितामब्रवीत् कपिः /
रामः सीते न जानीते ज्ञात्वा त्वां स नयिष्यति //
9.m: why does Rāma not lead [you] away?" To her who was doubtful, the monkey said: / "O Sītā, Rāma does not know; once he knows, he will take you away,

9.s:
rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasaṃ hatvā sabalaṃ devi mā śuca /
sābhijñānaṃ dehi me tvaṃ maṇiṃ sītādadatkapau //
9.d:
रावणं राक्षसं हत्वा सबलं देवि मा शुच /
साभिज्ञानं देहि मे त्वं मणिं सीताददत्कपौ //
9.m: having slain the rākṣasa Rāvaṇa along with his army. O lady, do not grieve! / Give me a token [for him]." Sītā gave a crest-jewel to the monkey

9.s:
uvāca māṃ yathā rāmo nayecchīghraṃ tathā kuru /
:n
1 rāmaś ca iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 tvāṃ mārgayet preṣayecca māmiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 21
kākākṣipātanakathām pratiyāhi hi śokaha //
9.d:
उवाच मां यथा रामो नयेच्छीघ्रं तथा कुरु /
:न्
1 रामश् च इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 त्वां मार्गयेत् प्रेषयेच्च मामिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 21
काकाक्षिपातनकथाम् प्रतियाहि हि शोकह //
9.m:
and said: "Act in such a way that Rāma may take me away quickly.
[Note]
1. "rāmaś ca" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
2. "tvāṃ mārgayet preṣayecca mām" is the reading of the manuscript marked gha. / [Page 21]
Go back [with] the story of the piercing of the crow's eye, O dispeller of grief!"

9.s:
maṇiṃ kathāṃ gṛhītvāha hanūmānneṣyate patiḥ /
athavā te tvarā kācit pṛṣṭhamāruha me śubhe //
9.d:
मणिं कथां गृहीत्वाह हनूमान्नेष्यते पतिः /
अथवा ते त्वरा काचित् पृष्ठमारुह मे शुभे //
9.m: Taking the jewel and the story, Hanumān said: "Your husband will take you away. / Or if there is any haste for you, mount upon my back, O auspicious lady!

9.s:
adya tvāṃ darśayiṣyāmi sasugrīvañca rāghavam /
sītābravīddhanūmantaṃ nayatāṃ māṃ hi rāghavaḥ //
9.d:
अद्य त्वां दर्शयिष्यामि ससुग्रीवञ्च राघवम् /
सीताब्रवीद्धनूमन्तं नयतां मां हि राघवः //
9.m: Today I will show you to the descendant of Raghu together with Sugrīva." / Sītā said to Hanumān: "Let the descendant of Raghu indeed take me away."

9.s:
hanūmān sa daśagrīva darśanopāyamākarot /
vanaṃ babhañja tatpālān hatvā dantanakhādibhiḥ //
9.d:
हनूमान् स दशग्रीव दर्शनोपायमाकरोत् /
वनं बभञ्ज तत्पालान् हत्वा दन्तनखादिभिः //
9.m: Hanumān devised a means to see the Ten-necked one: / he laid waste to the grove, having slain its guardians with teeth, nails, and other weapons.

9.s:
hatvātu kiṅkarān sarvān sapta mantrisutānapi /
putramakṣaṃ kumārañca śakrajicca babandha tam //
9.d:
हत्वातु किङ्करान् सर्वान् सप्त मन्त्रिसुतानपि /
पुत्रमक्षं कुमारञ्च शक्रजिच्च बबन्ध तम् //
9.m: Having slain all the kiṅkaras and also the seven sons of the ministers, / and the prince, his son Akṣa, Śakrajit bound him.

9.s:
nāgapāśena piṅgākṣaṃ darśayāmāsa rāvaṇam /
uvāca rāvaṇaḥ kastvaṃ mārutiḥ prāha rāvaṇam //
9.d:
नागपाशेन पिङ्गाक्षं दर्शयामास रावणम् /
उवाच रावणः कस्त्वं मारुतिः प्राह रावणम् //
9.m: With the serpent-noose he bound the yellow-eyed one and presented him to Rāvaṇa. / Rāvaṇa said: "Who are you?" The son of Marut said to Rāvaṇa:

9.s:
rāmadūto rāghavāya sītāṃ dehi mariṣyasi /
rāmabāṇair hataḥ sārdhaṃ laṅkāsthai rākṣasair dhruvam //
9.d:
रामदूतो राघवाय सीतां देहि मरिष्यसि /
रामबाणैर् हतः सार्धं लङ्कास्थै राक्षसैर् ध्रुवम् //
9.m: "I am the messenger of Rāma. Give Sītā to the descendant of Raghu, [or] you will die, / surely slain by Rāma's arrows together with the rākṣasas dwelling in Laṅkā."

9.s:
rāvaṇo hantumudyukto vibhīṣaṇanivāritaḥ /
dīpayāmāsa lāṅgalaṃ dīptapucchaḥ sa mārutiḥ //
9.d:
रावणो हन्तुमुद्युक्तो विभीषणनिवारितः /
दीपयामास लाङ्गलं दीप्तपुच्छः स मारुतिः //
9.m: Rāvaṇa, prepared to kill him, was restrained by Vibhīṣaṇa. / He set fire to [Hanumān's] tail; with his tail blazing, that son of Marut,

9.s:
dagdhvā laṅkāṃ rākṣasāṃś ca dṛṣṭvā sītāṃ praṇamya tām /
samudrapāramāgamya dṛṣṭā sīteti cābravīt //
9.d:
दग्ध्वा लङ्कां राक्षसांश् च दृष्ट्वा सीतां प्रणम्य ताम् /
समुद्रपारमागम्य दृष्टा सीतेति चाब्रवीत् //
9.m: having burnt Laṅkā and the rākṣasas, having seen Sītā and bowed to her, / came to the shore of the ocean and said: "Sītā has been seen!"

9.s:
aṅgadādīnaṅgadādyaiḥ pītvā madhuvane madhu /
jitvā dadhimukhādīṃś ca dṛṣṭvā rāmañca te 'bruvan //
9.d:
अङ्गदादीनङ्गदाद्यैः पीत्वा मधुवने मधु /
जित्वा दधिमुखादींश् च दृष्ट्वा रामञ्च ते ऽब्रुवन् //
9.m: to Aṅgada and the others. Having drunk honey in Madhuvana with Aṅgada and the rest, / and having defeated Dadhimukha and the others, they saw Rāma and said:

9.s:
dṛṣṭā sīteti rāmo 'pi hṛṣṭaḥ papraccha mārutim /
kathaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvayā sītā kimuvāca ca māmprati //
9.d:
दृष्टा सीतेति रामो ऽपि हृष्टः पप्रच्छ मारुतिम् /
कथं दृष्ट्वा त्वया सीता किमुवाच च माम्प्रति //
9.m: "Sītā has been seen!" Rāma too, delighted, questioned the son of Marut: / "How was Sītā seen by you, and what did she say to me?

9.s:
sītākathāmṛtenaiva siñca māṃ kāmavahnigam /
hanūmānabravīdrāmaṃ laṅghayitvābdhimāgataḥ //
9.d:
सीताकथामृतेनैव सिञ्च मां कामवह्निगम् /
हनूमानब्रवीद्रामं लङ्घयित्वाब्धिमागतः //
9.m: Sprinkle me, who have entered the fire of passion, with the nectar of news of Sītā!" / Hanumān said to Rāma: "Having crossed the ocean, I have returned,

9.s:
sītāṃ dṛṣṭvā purīṃ dagdhvā sītāmaṇiṃ gṛhāṇa vai /
hatvā tvaṃ rāvaṇaṃ sītāṃ prāpsyase rāma mā śuca //
9.d:
सीतां दृष्ट्वा पुरीं दग्ध्वा सीतामणिं गृहाण वै /
हत्वा त्वं रावणं सीतां प्राप्स्यसे राम मा शुच //
9.m: having seen Sītā and burnt the city. Take indeed Sītā's jewel! / Having slain Rāvaṇa, you will regain Sītā, O Rāma; do not grieve!"

9.s:
gṛhītvā taṃ maṇiṃ rāmo ruroda virahāturaḥ /
:p 22
maṇiṃ dṛṣṭvā jānakī me dṛṣṭā sītā nayasva mām //
9.d:
गृहीत्वा तं मणिं रामो रुरोद विरहातुरः /
:प् 22
मणिं दृष्ट्वा जानकी मे दृष्टा सीता नयस्व माम् //
9.m:
Taking that jewel, Rāma wept, tormented by separation:
[Page 22]
"Having seen the jewel, Jānakī has been seen by me! Sītā! Lead me [to her]!

9.s:
tayā vinā na jīvāmi sugrīvādyaiḥ prabodhitaḥ /
samudratīraṃ gatavān tatra rāmaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ //
9.d:
तया विना न जीवामि सुग्रीवाद्यैः प्रबोधितः /
समुद्रतीरं गतवान् तत्र रामं विभीषणः //
9.m: Without her I cannot live." Consuled by Sugrīva and the others, / he went to the seashore. There Vibhīṣaṇa came to Rāma,

9.s:
gatastiraskṛto bhrātrā rāvaṇena durātmanā /
rāmāya dehi sītāṃ tva mityuktenāsahāyavān //
9.d:
गतस्तिरस्कृतो भ्रात्रा रावणेन दुरात्मना /
रामाय देहि सीतां त्व मित्युक्तेनासहायवान् //
9.m: having departed, reviled by his evil-minded brother Rāvaṇa / who was told: "Give Sītā to Rāma!" Thus he was without any supporter.

9.s:
rāmo vibhīṣaṇaṃ mitraṃ laṅkaiśvarye 'bhyaṣecayat /
samudraṃ prārthayanmārgaṃ yadā nāyāttadā śaraiḥ //
9.d:
रामो विभीषणं मित्रं लङ्कैश्वर्ये ऽभ्यषेचयत् /
समुद्रं प्रार्थयन्मार्गं यदा नायात्तदा शरैः //
9.m: Rāma consecrated as an ally Vibhīṣaṇa in the sovereignty of Laṅkā. / Begging the ocean for a passage, when it did not appear, then with arrows

9.s:
bhedayāmāsa rāmañca uvācābdhiḥ samāgataḥ /
nalena setuṃ badhvābdhau laṅkāṃ vraja gabhīrakaḥ //
9.d:
भेदयामास रामञ्च उवाचाब्धिः समागतः /
नलेन सेतुं बध्वाब्धौ लङ्कां व्रज गभीरकः //
9.m: Rāma pierced it. And the ocean, having come, said: / "Having built a bridge across the ocean with Nala, go to Laṅkā. Deep

9.s:
ahaṃ tvayā kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ rāmo 'pi nalasetunā /
kṛtena taruśailādyair gataḥ pāraṃ mahodadheḥ //
vānaraiḥ sa suvelasthaḥ saha laṅkāṃ dadarśa vai //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe sundarakāṇḍavarṇanaṃ
nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śrīrāmāvatāravarṇanaṃ
9.d:
अहं त्वया कृतः पूर्वं रामो ऽपि नलसेतुना /
कृतेन तरुशैलाद्यैर् गतः पारं महोदधेः //
वानरैः स सुवेलस्थः सह लङ्कां ददर्श वै //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये रामायणे सुन्दरकाण्डवर्णनं
नाम नवमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ दशमो ऽध्यायः
श्रीरामावतारवर्णनं
9.m:
was I made by you in former times." Rāma too, by means of Nala's bridge / made of trees, rocks, and other materials, went to the far shore of the great ocean. / Stationed on Mount Suvela together with the monkeys, he beheld Laṅkā.
Thus, in the first great Purāṇa, the Āgneya, in the Rāmāyaṇa, the description of the Sundarakāṇḍa, being the ninth chapter.
Now begins the tenth chapter.
Description of the incarnation of the blessed Rāma.

10.s:
nārāda uvāca
rāmoktaścāṅgado gatvā rāvaṇaṃ prāha jānakī /
dīyatāṃ rāghavāyāśu anyathā tvaṃ mariṣyasi //
10.d:
नाराद उवाच
रामोक्तश्चाङ्गदो गत्वा रावणं प्राह जानकी /
दीयतां राघवायाशु अन्यथा त्वं मरिष्यसि //
10.m:
Nārada said:
And instructed by Rāma, Aṅgada went and said to Rāvaṇa: "Let Jānakī / be given to the descendant of Raghu at once; otherwise you will die!"

10.s:
rāvaṇo hantumudyuktaḥ saṅgrāmoddhatarākṣasaḥ /
rāmāyāha daśagrīvo yuddhamekaṃ tu manyate //
10.d:
रावणो हन्तुमुद्युक्तः सङ्ग्रामोद्धतराक्षसः /
रामायाह दशग्रीवो युद्धमेकं तु मन्यते //
10.m: Rāvaṇa, prepared to kill [him], the rākṣasa haughty in battle, / the Ten-necked one said to Rāma: "Battle alone is what is considered!"

10.s:
rāmo yuddhāya tac chrutvā laṅkāṃ sakapirāyayau /
vānaro hanūmān maindo dvivido jāmbavānnalaḥ //
10.d:
रामो युद्धाय तच् छ्रुत्वा लङ्कां सकपिराययौ /
वानरो हनूमान् मैन्दो द्विविदो जाम्बवान्नलः //
10.m: Having heard that, Rāma came to Laṅkā for battle, accompanied by the monkeys: / the monkey Hanumān, Mainda, Dvivida, Jāmbavān, Nala,

10.s:
nīlastāroṅgado dhūmraḥ suṣeṇaḥ keśarī gayaḥ /
:p 23
panaso vinato rambhaḥ śarabhaḥ krathano balī //
10.d:
नीलस्तारोङ्गदो धूम्रः सुषेणः केशरी गयः /
:प् 23
पनसो विनतो रम्भः शरभः क्रथनो बली //
10.m:
Nīla, Tāra, Aṅgada, Dhūmra, Suṣeṇa, Keśarī, Gaya,
[Page 23]
Panasa, Vinata, Rambha, Śarabha, Krathana the strong,

10.s:
gavākṣo dadhivaktraś ca gavayo gandhamādanaḥ /
ete cānye ca sugrīva etair yukto hy asaṅkhyakaiḥ //
10.d:
गवाक्षो दधिवक्त्रश् च गवयो गन्धमादनः /
एते चान्ये च सुग्रीव एतैर् युक्तो ह्य् असङ्ख्यकैः //
10.m: Gavākṣa, Dadhivaktra, Gavaya, and Gandhamādana, / and these and others, and Sugrīva—accompanied by these innumerable ones indeed,

10.s:
rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāñca yuddhaṃ saṅkulamābabhau /
rākṣasā vānarān jaghnuḥ śaraśaktigadādibhiḥ //
10.d:
रक्षसां वानराणाञ्च युद्धं सङ्कुलमाबभौ /
राक्षसा वानरान् जघ्नुः शरशक्तिगदादिभिः //
10.m: a tumultuous battle of the rākṣasas and monkeys shone forth. / The rākṣasas struck the monkeys with arrows, lances, maces, and the like;

10.s:
vānarā rākṣasāñ jaghnur nakhadantaśilādibhiḥ /
hastyaśvarathapādātaṃ rākṣasānāṃ balaṃ hataṃ //
10.d:
वानरा राक्षसाञ् जघ्नुर् नखदन्तशिलादिभिः /
हस्त्यश्वरथपादातं राक्षसानां बलं हतं //
10.m: the monkeys struck the rākṣasas with nails, teeth, rocks, and the like. / The army of the rākṣasas, consisting of elephants, horses, chariots, and foot-soldiers, was destroyed.

10.s:
hanūmān giriśṛṅgeṇa dhūmrākṣamabadhīdripum /
akampanaṃ prahastañca yudhyantaṃ nīla ābadhīt //
10.d:
हनूमान् गिरिशृङ्गेण धूम्राक्षमबधीद्रिपुम् /
अकम्पनं प्रहस्तञ्च युध्यन्तं नील आबधीत् //
10.m: Hanumān slew the enemy Dhūmrākṣa with a mountain peak; / Nīla slew Akampana and Prahasta as they fought.

10.s:
indrajicccharabandhācca vimuktau rāmalakṣmaṇau /
tārkṣasandarśanādvāṇair jaghnatū rākṣasaṃ balam //
10.d:
इन्द्रजिच्च्छरबन्धाच्च विमुक्तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ /
तार्क्षसन्दर्शनाद्वाणैर् जघ्नतू राक्षसं बलम् //
10.m: And Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa, freed from Indrajit's arrow-bonds / upon the sight of Tārkṣya, with their arrows struck the rākṣasa host.

10.s:
rāmaḥ śarair jarjaritaṃ rāvaṇañcākarodraṇe /
rāvanaḥ kumbhakarṇañca bodhayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ //
10.d:
रामः शरैर् जर्जरितं रावणञ्चाकरोद्रणे /
रावनः कुम्भकर्णञ्च बोधयामास दुःखितः //
10.m: Rāma shattered Rāvaṇa in battle with arrows. / Distressed, Rāvaṇa awakened Kumbhakarṇa.

10.s:
kumbhakarṇaḥ prabuddho 'tha pītvā ghaṭasahasrakam /
madyasya mahiṣādīnāṃ bhakṣayitvāha rāvaṇam //
10.d:
कुम्भकर्णः प्रबुद्धो ऽथ पीत्वा घटसहस्रकम् /
मद्यस्य महिषादीनां भक्षयित्वाह रावणम् //
10.m: Then Kumbhakarṇa, awakened, having drunk a thousand jars / of wine and devoured buffaloes and other animals, said to Rāvaṇa:

10.s:
sītāyā haraṇaṃ pāpaṃ kṛtantvaṃ hi gururyataḥ /
ato gacchāmi yuddhāya rāmaṃ hanmi savānaram //
10.d:
सीताया हरणं पापं कृतन्त्वं हि गुरुर्यतः /
अतो गच्छामि युद्धाय रामं हन्मि सवानरम् //
10.m: "The abduction of Sītā was a sin committed [by you]; yet because you are an elder, / therefore I go to battle, and I will slay Rāma together with the monkeys."

10.s:
ityuktvā vānarān sarvān kumbhakarṇo mamarda ha /
gṛhītastena sugrīvaḥ karṇanāsaṃ cakarta saḥ //
10.d:
इत्युक्त्वा वानरान् सर्वान् कुम्भकर्णो ममर्द ह /
गृहीतस्तेन सुग्रीवः कर्णनासं चकर्त सः //
10.m: Having spoken thus, Kumbhakarṇa crushed all the monkeys. / Seized by him, Sugrīva cut off his ears and nose.

10.s:
karṇanāsāvihīno 'sau bhakṣayāmāsa vānarān /
rāmo 'tha kumbhakarṇasya bāhū ciccheda śāyakaiḥ //
10.d:
कर्णनासाविहीनो ऽसौ भक्षयामास वानरान् /
रामो ऽथ कुम्भकर्णस्य बाहू चिच्छेद शायकैः //
10.m: Deprived of ears and nose, he devoured the monkeys. / Then Rāma severed Kumbhakarṇa's arms with arrows.

10.s:
tataḥ pādau tataśchitvā śiro bhūmau vyapātayat /
atha kumbho nikumbhaś ca makarākṣaś ca rākṣasaḥ //
10.d:
ततः पादौ ततश्छित्वा शिरो भूमौ व्यपातयत् /
अथ कुम्भो निकुम्भश् च मकराक्षश् च राक्षसः //
10.m: Then his feet, and then cutting off his head, he felled it to the earth. / Then the rākṣasas Kumbha, Nikumbha, and Makarākṣa,

10.s:
mahodaro mahāpārśvo matta unmattarākṣasaḥ /
praghaso bhāsakarṇaś ca virūpākṣaś ca saṃyuge //
10.d:
महोदरो महापार्श्वो मत्त उन्मत्तराक्षसः /
प्रघसो भासकर्णश् च विरूपाक्षश् च संयुगे //
10.m: Mahodara, Mahāpārśva, Matta, the rākṣasa Unmatta, / Praghasa, Bhāsakarṇa, and Virūpākṣa in battle,

10.s:
devāntako narāntaś ca triśirāścātikāyakaḥ /
:p 24
rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇenaite vānaraiḥ savibhīṣaṇaiḥ //
10.d:
देवान्तको नरान्तश् च त्रिशिराश्चातिकायकः /
:प् 24
रामेण लक्ष्मणेनैते वानरैः सविभीषणैः //
10.m:
Devāntaka, Narāntaka, Triśiras, and Atikāya,
[Page 24]
fighting with Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, / and the monkeys accompanied by Vibhīṣaṇa,

10.s:
yudhyamānāstayā hy anye rākṣasā bhuvi pātitāḥ /
indrajinmāyayā yudhyan rāmādīn sambabandha ha //
10.d:
युध्यमानास्तया ह्य् अन्ये राक्षसा भुवि पातिताः /
इन्द्रजिन्मायया युध्यन् रामादीन् सम्बबन्ध ह //
10.m: as well as other rākṣasas, were felled to the earth. / Indrajit, fighting with sorcery, bound Rāma and the others

10.s:
varadattair nāgabāṇaiḥ(1) oṣadhyā tau viśalyakau /
viśalyayābraṇau kṛtvā mārutyānītaparvate //
10.d:
वरदत्तैर् नागबाणैः(1) ओषध्या तौ विशल्यकौ /
विशल्ययाब्रणौ कृत्वा मारुत्यानीतपर्वते //
10.m: with serpent-arrows granted by a boon. With the herb that extracts arrows, making the two free from arrows / and uninjured, on the mountain brought by the son of Marut,

10.s:
hanūmān dhārayāmāsa tatrāgaṃ yatra saṃsthitaḥ /
nikumbhilāyāṃ homādi kurvantaṃ taṃ hi lakṣmaṇaḥ //
10.d:
हनूमान् धारयामास तत्रागं यत्र संस्थितः /
निकुम्भिलायां होमादि कुर्वन्तं तं हि लक्ष्मणः //
10.m: Hanūmān held that mountain where he stood. / Indeed, Lakṣmaṇa [attacked] him as he performed fire oblations and other rites at Nikumbhilā;

10.s:
śarair indrajitaṃ vīraṃ yuddhe taṃ tu vyaśātayat /
rāvaṇaḥ śokasantaptaḥ sītāṃ hantuṃ samudyataḥ //
10.d:
शरैर् इन्द्रजितं वीरं युद्धे तं तु व्यशातयत् /
रावणः शोकसन्तप्तः सीतां हन्तुं समुद्यतः //
10.m: with arrows in battle he struck down that heroic Indrajit. / Rāvaṇa, tormented by grief, prepared to kill Sītā.

10.s:
avindhyavārito(2) rājā rathasthaḥ sabalo yayau /
indrokto mātalī rāmaṃ rathasthaṃ pracakāra tam //
10.d:
अविन्ध्यवारितो(2) राजा रथस्थः सबलो ययौ /
इन्द्रोक्तो मातली रामं रथस्थं प्रचकार तम् //
10.m: Dissuaded by Avindhya, the king went forth in his chariot with his army. / Instructed by Indra, Mātali placed Rāma in his chariot.

10.s:
rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇayoriva /
rāvaṇo vānarān hanti mārutyādyāś ca rāvaṇam //
10.d:
रामरावणयोर्युद्धं रामरावणयोरिव /
रावणो वानरान् हन्ति मारुत्याद्याश् च रावणम् //
10.m: The battle between Rāma and Rāvaṇa was like that between Rāma and Rāvaṇa alone. / Rāvaṇa killed the monkeys, and the son of Marut and others [attacked] Rāvaṇa.

10.s:
rāmaḥ śastraistamastraiś ca vavardha jalado yathā /
tasya dhvajaṃ sa ciccheda rathamaśvāṃś ca sārathim //
10.d:
रामः शस्त्रैस्तमस्त्रैश् च ववर्ध जलदो यथा /
तस्य ध्वजं स चिच्छेद रथमश्वांश् च सारथिम् //
10.m: Rāma showered him with weapons and missile weapons like a cloud. / He severed his banner, chariot, horses, and charioteer,

10.s:
dhanurbāhūñchirāṃsyeva uttiṣṭhanti śirāṃsi hi /
paitāmahena hṛdayaṃ bhitvā rāmeṇa rāvaṇaḥ //
10.d:
धनुर्बाहूञ्छिरांस्येव उत्तिष्ठन्ति शिरांसि हि /
पैतामहेन हृदयं भित्वा रामेण रावणः //
10.m: his bow, arms, and indeed his heads; yet the heads kept rising again. / Piercing Rāvaṇa's chest with [the missile] of Brahmā,

10.s:
bhūtale pātitaḥ sarvai rākṣasai ruruduḥ striyaḥ /
āśvāsya tañca saṃskṛtya rāmājñapto vibhīṣaṇaḥ //
10.d:
भूतले पातितः सर्वै राक्षसै रुरुदुः स्त्रियः /
आश्वास्य तञ्च संस्कृत्य रामाज्ञप्तो विभीषणः //
10.m: Rāma felled him to the surface of the earth. All the rākṣasa women wept. / Vibhīṣaṇa, commanded by Rāma, consoled them and performed the funeral rites for him.

10.s:
hanūmatānayadrāmaḥ sītāṃ śuddhāṃ gṛhītavān /
rāmo vahnau praviṣṭāntāṃ śuddhāmindrādibhiḥ stutaḥ //
10.d:
हनूमतानयद्रामः सीतां शुद्धां गृहीतवान् /
रामो वह्नौ प्रविष्टान्तां शुद्धामिन्द्रादिभिः स्तुतः //
10.m: Rāma had Sītā brought by Hanūmān and accepted her once purified. / When she entered the fire and was proved pure, Rāma was praised by Indra and the others,

10.s:
brahmaṇā daśarathena tvaṃ viṣṇū rākṣasamardanaḥ /
indrorcito 'mṛtavṛṣṭyā jīvayāmāsa vānarān //
:n
1 nāgapaśair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 suhṛnnivārita iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 25
10.d:
ब्रह्मणा दशरथेन त्वं विष्णू राक्षसमर्दनः /
इन्द्रोर्चितो ऽमृतवृष्ट्या जीवयामास वानरान् //
:न्
1 नागपशैर् इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 सुहृन्निवारित इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 25
10.m:
by Brahmā, and by Daśaratha: “You are Viṣṇu, the slayer of the rākṣasas.” / Honoured by Indra, he revived the monkeys with a shower of nectar.
[Note]
1. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is nāgapāśaiḥ ("with serpent-nooses").
2. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is suhṛnnivāritaḥ ("restrained by his friend"). / [Page 25]

10.s:
rāmeṇa pūjitā jagmur yuddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā divañca te /
rāmo vibhīṣaṇāyādāl laṅkāmabhyarcya vānarān //
10.d:
रामेण पूजिता जग्मुर् युद्धं दृष्ट्वा दिवञ्च ते /
रामो विभीषणायादाल् लङ्कामभ्यर्च्य वानरान् //
10.m: Honoured by Rāma, having watched the battle, they went to heaven. / Rāma gave Laṅkā to Vibhīṣaṇa and, having honoured the monkeys,

10.s:
sasītaḥ puṣpake sthitvā gatamārgeṇa vai gataḥ(1) /
darśayan vanadurgāṇi sītāyai hṛṣṭamānasaḥ //
10.d:
ससीतः पुष्पके स्थित्वा गतमार्गेण वै गतः(1) /
दर्शयन् वनदुर्गाणि सीतायै हृष्टमानसः //
10.m: seated in the Puṣpaka [aerial chariot] with Sītā, he departed along the path he had come, / showing the forest strongholds to Sītā with a delighted heart.

10.s:
bharadvājaṃ namaskṛtya nandigrāmaṃ samāgataḥ /
bharatena nataścāgād ayodhyāntatra saṃsthitaḥ //
10.d:
भरद्वाजं नमस्कृत्य नन्दिग्रामं समागतः /
भरतेन नतश्चागाद् अयोध्यान्तत्र संस्थितः //
10.m: Having paid homage to Bharadvāja, he arrived at Nandigrāma. / Bowed to by Bharata, he proceeded to Ayodhyā and took up residence there.

10.s:
vasiṣṭhādīnnamaskṛtya kauśalyāñcaiva kekayīm /
sumitrāṃ prāptarājyo 'tha dvijādīn so 'bhyapūjayat //
10.d:
वसिष्ठादीन्नमस्कृत्य कौशल्याञ्चैव केकयीम् /
सुमित्रां प्राप्तराज्यो ऽथ द्विजादीन् सो ऽभ्यपूजयत् //
10.m: Having paid homage to Vasiṣṭha and the others, and to Kauśalyā, Kaikeyī, / and Sumitrā, having attained the kingdom, he then honoured the twice-born and others.

10.s:
vāsudevaṃ svamātmānam aśvamedhair athāyajat /
sarvadānāni sa dadau pālayāmāsa saḥ prajāḥ //
10.d:
वासुदेवं स्वमात्मानम् अश्वमेधैर् अथायजत् /
सर्वदानानि स ददौ पालयामास सः प्रजाः //
10.m: Then with horse sacrifices he worshipped his own Self, Vāsudeva. / He gave all manner of gifts and protected the subjects

10.s:
putravaddharmakāmādīn duṣṭanigrahaṇe rataḥ /
sarvadharmaparo lokaḥ sarvaśasyā ca medinī /
nākālamaraṇañcāsīd rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe yuddhakāṇḍavarṇanaṃ
nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
śrīrāmāvatāravarṇanaṃ
10.d:
पुत्रवद्धर्मकामादीन् दुष्टनिग्रहणे रतः /
सर्वधर्मपरो लोकः सर्वशस्या च मेदिनी /
नाकालमरणञ्चासीद् रामे राज्यं प्रशासति //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये रामायणे युद्धकाण्डवर्णनं
नाम दशमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ एकादशो ऽध्यायः
श्रीरामावतारवर्णनं
10.m:
like sons, devoted to righteousness, pleasure, and the like, and intent on punishing the wicked. / All people were devoted to righteousness, the earth was full of crops, / and there was no untimely death while Rāma ruled the kingdom.
Thus ends the tenth chapter, named "Description of the Yuddhakāṇḍa" in the Rāmāyaṇa, in the ancient Great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now the eleventh chapter.
Description of the Incarnation of Śrī Rāma.

11.s:
nārada uvāca
rājyasthaṃ rāghavaṃ jagmur agastyādyāḥ supūjitāḥ /
dhanyastvaṃ vijayī yasmād indrajidvinipātitaḥ //
11.d:
नारद उवाच
राज्यस्थं राघवं जग्मुर् अगस्त्याद्याः सुपूजिताः /
धन्यस्त्वं विजयी यस्माद् इन्द्रजिद्विनिपातितः //
11.m: Nārada said: / Agastya and other [sages], highly revered, came to the descendant of Raghu who was established on the throne: / “Blessed are you, victorious, because Indrajit has been felled!

11.s:
brahmātmajaḥ pulastyobhūt viśravāstasya naikaṣī /
puṣpotkaṭābhūt prathamā tatputrobhūddhaneśvaraḥ //
11.d:
ब्रह्मात्मजः पुलस्त्योभूत् विश्रवास्तस्य नैकषी /
पुष्पोत्कटाभूत् प्रथमा तत्पुत्रोभूद्धनेश्वरः //
11.m: Brahmā's son was Pulastya; his son was Viśravas. His [wife] was Naikaṣī; / Puṣpotkaṭā was his first [wife], and her son was the lord of wealth [Kubera].

11.s:
naikaṣyāṃ rāvaṇo jajñe viṃśadbāhurdaśānanaḥ /
:n
1 svargamārgeṇa vai gata iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 26
tapasā brahmadattena vareṇa jitadaivataḥ //
11.d:
नैकष्यां रावणो जज्ञे विंशद्बाहुर्दशाननः /
:न्
1 स्वर्गमार्गेण वै गत इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 26
तपसा ब्रह्मदत्तेन वरेण जितदैवतः //
11.m:
Upon Naikaṣī, Rāvaṇa was born, twenty-armed and ten-faced,
[Note]
1. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is svargamārgeṇa vai gataḥ ("went by the path of heaven"). / [Page 26]
who conquered the deities through a boon granted by Brahmā on account of his ascetic austerity.

11.s:
kumbhakarṇaḥ sanidro 'bhūd dharmiṣṭho 'bhūdvibhīṣaṇaḥ /
svasā śūrpaṇakhā teṣāṃ rāvaṇānmeghanādakaḥ //
11.d:
कुम्भकर्णः सनिद्रो ऽभूद् धर्मिष्ठो ऽभूद्विभीषणः /
स्वसा शूर्पणखा तेषां रावणान्मेघनादकः //
11.m: Kumbhakarṇa was given to sleep; Vibhīṣaṇa was very righteous; / Śūrpaṇakhā was their sister; and from Rāvaṇa came Meghanāda.

11.s:
indraṃ jitvendrajiccābhūd rāvaṇādadhiko balī /
hatastvayā lakṣmaṇena devādeḥ kṣemamicchatā //
11.d:
इन्द्रं जित्वेन्द्रजिच्चाभूद् रावणादधिको बली /
हतस्त्वया लक्ष्मणेन देवादेः क्षेममिच्छता //
11.m: Having conquered Indra, he became Indrajit, mightier even than Rāvaṇa. / Desiring the welfare of the gods and others, you, along with Lakṣmaṇa, killed him.”

11.s:
ityuktvā te gatā viprā agastyādyā namaskṛtāḥ /
devaprārthitarāmoktaḥ śatrughno lavaṇārdanaḥ //
11.d:
इत्युक्त्वा ते गता विप्रा अगस्त्याद्या नमस्कृताः /
देवप्रार्थितरामोक्तः शत्रुघ्नो लवणार्दनः //
11.m: Having spoken thus and having been saluted, those brāhmaṇas, Agastya and others, departed. / Commanded by Rāma at the request of the gods, Śatrughna, the crusher of Lavaṇa,

11.s:
abhūt pūrmathurā kācit rāmokto bharato 'vadhīt /
koṭitrayañca śailūṣa- putrāṇāṃ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ //
11.d:
अभूत् पूर्मथुरा काचित् रामोक्तो भरतो ऽवधीत् /
कोटित्रयञ्च शैलूष- पुत्राणां निशितैः शरैः //
11.m: founded the city of Mathurā. Commanded by Rāma, Bharata killed / with sharp arrows thirty million sons of Śailūṣa,

11.s:
śailūṣaṃ duṣṭagandharvaṃ sindhutīranivāsinam /
takṣañca puṣkaraṃ putraṃ sthāpayitvātha deśayoḥ //
11.d:
शैलूषं दुष्टगन्धर्वं सिन्धुतीरनिवासिनम् /
तक्षञ्च पुष्करं पुत्रं स्थापयित्वाथ देशयोः //
11.m: and Śailūṣa the wicked Gandharva who dwelled on the bank of the Indus. / Then, having established his sons Takṣa and Puṣkara in the two regions,

11.s:
bharatogātsaśatrughno rāghavaṃ pūjayan sthitaḥ /
rāmo duṣṭānnihatyājau śiṣṭān sampālya mānavaḥ //
11.d:
भरतोगात्सशत्रुघ्नो राघवं पूजयन् स्थितः /
रामो दुष्टान्निहत्याजौ शिष्टान् सम्पाल्य मानवः //
11.m: Bharata returned with Śatrughna and remained, revering the descendant of Raghu. / Rāma, having slain the wicked in battle and protected the virtuous as a mortal,

11.s:
putrau kuśalavau jātau vālmīkerāśrame varau /
lokāpavādāttyaktāyāṃ jñātau sucaritaśravāt //
11.d:
पुत्रौ कुशलवौ जातौ वाल्मीकेराश्रमे वरौ /
लोकापवादात्त्यक्तायां ज्ञातौ सुचरितश्रवात् //
11.m: had two noble sons born in Vālmīki's hermitage, Kuśa and Lava, / to [Sītā] who had been abandoned due to public slander; they became known through the recitation of [Rāma's] virtuous deeds.

11.s:
rājyebhiṣicya brahmāham asmīti dhyānatatparaḥ /
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca //
11.d:
राज्येभिषिच्य ब्रह्माहम् अस्मीति ध्यानतत्परः /
दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशवर्षशतानि च //
11.m: Having consecrated [them] to the kingdom, intent on meditating 'I am Brahman', / after having ruled for ten thousand years and ten hundred years,

11.s:
rājyaṃ kṛtvā kratūn kṛtvā svargaṃ devārcito yayau /
sapauraḥ sānujaḥ sītā- putro janapadānvitaḥ //
11.d:
राज्यं कृत्वा क्रतून् कृत्वा स्वर्गं देवार्चितो ययौ /
सपौरः सानुजः सीता- पुत्रो जनपदान्वितः //
11.m: and performed sacrifices, worshipped by the gods he went to heaven, / together with the citizens, his younger brothers, the sons of Sītā, and the people of the countryside.

11.s:
agnir uvāca
vālmīkir nāradācchrutvā rāmāyaṇamakārayat /
savistaraṃ yadetacca śṛṇuyātsa divaṃ vrajet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe uttarakāṇḍavarṇanaṃ
nāma ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:p 27
:ś atha dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
śrīharivaṃśavarṇanaṃ
11.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
वाल्मीकिर् नारदाच्छ्रुत्वा रामायणमकारयत् /
सविस्तरं यदेतच्च शृणुयात्स दिवं व्रजेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये रामायणे उत्तरकाण्डवर्णनं
नाम एकादशो ऽध्यायः
:प् 27
:श् अथ द्वादशो ऽध्यायः
श्रीहरिवंशवर्णनं
11.m:
Agni said: / Vālmīki, having heard it from Nārada, composed the Rāmāyaṇa / in detail. Whoever listens to this shall go to heaven.
Thus ends the eleventh chapter, named "Description of the Uttarakāṇḍa" in the Rāmāyaṇa, in the ancient Great Purāṇa of Agni. / [Page 27]
Now the twelfth chapter.
Description of the Harivaṃśa.

12.s:
agnir uvāca
harivaṃśampravakṣyāmi viṣṇunābhyambujādajaḥ(1) /
brahmaṇotristataḥ somaḥ somājjātaḥ purūravāḥ //
12.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
हरिवंशम्प्रवक्ष्यामि विष्णुनाभ्यम्बुजादजः(1) /
ब्रह्मणोत्रिस्ततः सोमः सोमाज्जातः पुरूरवाः //
12.m: Agni said: / I will proclaim the Harivaṃśa. From the lotus of Viṣṇu's navel the Unborn [Brahmā] arose; / from Brahmā came Atri; from him, Soma; from Soma was born Purūravas.

12.s:
tasmādāyurabhūttasmān nahuṣo 'to yayātikaḥ /
yaduñca turvasuntasmād devayānī vyajāyata //
12.d:
तस्मादायुरभूत्तस्मान् नहुषो ऽतो ययातिकः /
यदुञ्च तुर्वसुन्तस्माद् देवयानी व्यजायत //
12.m: From him came Āyus; from him, Nahuṣa; from him, Yayāti. / From him Devayānī bore Yadu and Turvasu,

12.s:
druhyaṃ cānuṃ ca pūruṃ ca śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī /
yadoḥ kule yādavāś ca vasudevastaduttamaḥ //
12.d:
द्रुह्यं चानुं च पूरुं च शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी /
यदोः कुले यादवाश् च वसुदेवस्तदुत्तमः //
12.m: and Śarmiṣṭhā, daughter of Vṛṣaparvan, [bore] Druhyu, Anu, and Pūru. / In the lineage of Yadu were the Yādavas, and Vasudeva was the foremost of them.

12.s:
bhuvo bhārāvatārārthaṃ devakyāṃ vasudevataḥ /
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāḥ ṣaḍgarbhā yoganidrayā //
12.d:
भुवो भारावतारार्थं देवक्यां वसुदेवतः /
हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्राः षड्गर्भा योगनिद्रया //
12.m: To relieve the burden of the earth, from Vasudeva in Devakī / the six embryos, the sons of Hiraṇyakaśipu, were brought by Yoganidrā,

12.s:
viṣṇuprayuktayā nītā devakījaṭharaṃ purā /
abhūcca saptamo garbho devakyā jaṭharād balaḥ //
12.d:
विष्णुप्रयुक्तया नीता देवकीजठरं पुरा /
अभूच्च सप्तमो गर्भो देवक्या जठराद् बलः //
12.m: directed by Viṣṇu, into the womb of Devakī in the past. / And the seventh embryo from the womb of Devakī was Bala;

12.s:
saṅkrāmito 'bhūdrohiṇyāṃ rauhiṇeyastato hariḥ /
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāñca nabhasi ardharātre caturbhujaḥ //
12.d:
सङ्क्रामितो ऽभूद्रोहिण्यां रौहिणेयस्ततो हरिः /
कृष्णाष्टम्याञ्च नभसि अर्धरात्रे चतुर्भुजः //
12.m: he was transferred to Rohiṇī and thus became the son of Rohiṇī. Then Hari / on the eighth lunar day of the dark fortnight of Śrāvaṇa at midnight, four-armed,

12.s:
devakyā vasudevena stuto bālo dvibāhukaḥ /
vasudevaḥ kaṃsabhayād yaśodāśayane 'nayat //
12.d:
देवक्या वसुदेवेन स्तुतो बालो द्विबाहुकः /
वसुदेवः कंसभयाद् यशोदाशयने ऽनयत् //
12.m: praised by Devakī and Vasudeva, became a two-armed child. / Vasudeva, out of fear of Kaṃsa, carried him to the bed of Yaśodā.

12.s:
yaśodābālikāṃ gṛhya devakīśayane 'nayat /
kaṃso bāladhvaniṃ śrutvā tāñcikṣepa śilātale //
12.d:
यशोदाबालिकां गृह्य देवकीशयने ऽनयत् /
कंसो बालध्वनिं श्रुत्वा ताञ्चिक्षेप शिलातले //
12.m: Taking the baby girl of Yaśodā, he brought her to the bed of Devakī. / Kaṃsa, hearing the cry of the child, dashed her against the surface of a rock.

12.s:
vāritopi sa devakyā mṛtyurgarbhoṣṭamo mama /
śrutvāśarīriṇīṃ vācaṃ matto garbhāstu māritāḥ //
12.d:
वारितोपि स देवक्या मृत्युर्गर्भोष्टमो मम /
श्रुत्वाशरीरिणीं वाचं मत्तो गर्भास्तु मारिताः //
12.m: Although stopped by Devakī, [saying,] “The eighth pregnancy is my death,” / having heard the bodiless voice, the embryos were indeed killed by him.

12.s:
samarpitāstu devakyā vivāhasamayeritāḥ /
sā kṣiptā bālikā kaṃsam ākāśasthābravīdidam //
12.d:
समर्पितास्तु देवक्या विवाहसमयेरिताः /
सा क्षिप्ता बालिका कंसम् आकाशस्थाब्रवीदिदम् //
12.m: They were surrendered by Devakī, as promised at the time of the wedding. / That girl who was dashed, standing in the sky, said this to Kaṃsa:

12.s:
kiṃ mayā kṣiptayā kaṃsa jāto yastvāṃ badhiṣyati /
:n
1 viṣṇunābhyabjādaja iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 28
sarvasvabhūto devānāṃ bhūbhāraharaṇāya saḥ //
12.d:
किं मया क्षिप्तया कंस जातो यस्त्वां बधिष्यति /
:न्
1 विष्णुनाभ्यब्जादज इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 28
सर्वस्वभूतो देवानां भूभारहरणाय सः //
12.m:
“What is to be gained by having dashed me, O Kaṃsa? He who will slay you has been born!
[Footnote]
[Variant reading: 'viṣṇunābhyabjādaja' in manuscript Kha] / [p. 28]
He is the all-in-all of the gods, [born] to remove the burden of the earth.”

12.s:
ityuktvā sā ca śumbhādīn hatvendreṇa ca saṃstutā /
āryā durgā vedagarbhā ambikā bhadrakālyapi //
12.d:
इत्युक्त्वा सा च शुम्भादीन् हत्वेन्द्रेण च संस्तुता /
आर्या दुर्गा वेदगर्भा अम्बिका भद्रकाल्यपि //
12.m: Having spoken thus, she slew Śumbha and the others and was praised by Indra: / Āryā, Durgā, Vedagarbhā, Ambikā, and Bhadrakālī,

12.s:
bhadrā kṣemyā kṣemakarī naikabāhur namāmi tām /
trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennāma sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt //
12.d:
भद्रा क्षेम्या क्षेमकरी नैकबाहुर् नमामि ताम् /
त्रिसन्ध्यं यः पठेन्नाम सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात् //
12.m: Bhadrā, Kṣemyā, Kṣemakarī, Naikabāhu—I bow to her. / Whoever recites her names at the three junctures of the day shall obtain all desires.

12.s:
kaṃso 'pi pūtanādīṃś ca preṣayadbālanāśane /
yaśodāpatinandāya vasudevena cārpitau //
12.d:
कंसो ऽपि पूतनादींश् च प्रेषयद्बालनाशने /
यशोदापतिनन्दाय वसुदेवेन चार्पितौ //
12.m: Kaṃsa also dispatched Pūtanā and others to destroy children. / And [the boys] were entrusted by Vasudeva to Nanda, husband of Yaśodā,

12.s:
rakṣaṇāya ca kaṃsāder bhītenaiva hi gokule /
rāmakṛṣṇau ceratustau gobhirgopālakaiḥ saha //
12.d:
रक्षणाय च कंसादेर् भीतेनैव हि गोकुले /
रामकृष्णौ चेरतुस्तौ गोभिर्गोपालकैः सह //
12.m: for protection from Kaṃsa and the rest, out of sheer fear, in Gokula. / Those two, Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, roamed about with the cows and cowherd boys.

12.s:
sarvasya jagataḥ pālau gopālau tau babhūvatuḥ /
kṛṣṇaścolūkhale baddho dāmnā vyagrayaśodayā //
12.d:
सर्वस्य जगतः पालौ गोपालौ तौ बभूवतुः /
कृष्णश्चोलूखले बद्धो दाम्ना व्यग्रयशोदया //
12.m: The protectors of the entire universe, those two became cowherds. / And Kṛṣṇa was bound to a mortar with a rope by the agitated Yaśodā.

12.s:
yamalārjunamadhye 'gād bhagnau ca yamalārjunau /
parivṛttaś ca śakaṭaḥ pādakṣepāt stanārthinā //
12.d:
यमलार्जुनमध्ये ऽगाद् भग्नौ च यमलार्जुनौ /
परिवृत्तश् च शकटः पादक्षेपात् स्तनार्थिना //
12.m: He went between the twin arjuna trees, and the twin arjunas broke. / And the cart was overturned by a kick of the foot [by the child] seeking breast-milk.

12.s:
pūtanā stanapānena sā hatā hantumudyatā /
vṛndāvanagataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāliyaṃ yamunāhradāt //
12.d:
पूतना स्तनपानेन सा हता हन्तुमुद्यता /
वृन्दावनगतः कृष्णः कालियं यमुनाह्रदात् //
12.m: Pūtanā, who strove to kill him, was slain by the sucking of her breast. / Kṛṣṇa, having gone to Vṛndāvana, subdued Kāliya from the Yamunā pool,

12.s:
jitvā niḥsārya cābdhisthañ cakāra balasaṃstutaḥ /
kṣemaṃ tālavanaṃ cakre hatvā dhenukagardabhaṃ //
12.d:
जित्वा निःसार्य चाब्धिस्थञ् चकार बलसंस्तुतः /
क्षेमं तालवनं चक्रे हत्वा धेनुकगर्दभं //
12.m: drove him out, placed him in the ocean, and was praised by Bala. / He made the palm grove safe, having slain the donkey Dhenuka.

12.s:
ariṣṭavṛṣabhaṃ hatvā keśinaṃ hayarūpiṇam /
śakrotsavaṃ parityajya kārito gotrayajñakaḥ //
12.d:
अरिष्टवृषभं हत्वा केशिनं हयरूपिणम् /
शक्रोत्सवं परित्यज्य कारितो गोत्रयज्ञकः //
12.m: Having slain the bull Ariṣṭa and Keśin who had the form of a horse, / abandoning the festival of Śakra, he caused the sacrifice to the mountain to be performed.

12.s:
parvataṃ dhārayitvā ca śakrādvṛṣṭir nivāritā /
namaskṛto mahendreṇa govindo 'thārjunorpitaḥ //
12.d:
पर्वतं धारयित्वा च शक्राद्वृष्टिर् निवारिता /
नमस्कृतो महेन्द्रेण गोविन्दो ऽथार्जुनोर्पितः //
12.m: Having lifted the mountain, the rain from Śakra was warded off. / Bowed to by Mahendra, Govinda was then given to Arjuna [for protection].

12.s:
indrotsavastu tuṣṭena bhūyaḥ kṛṣṇena kāritaḥ /
rathastho mathurāñcāgāt kaṃsoktākrūrasaṃstutaḥ //
12.d:
इन्द्रोत्सवस्तु तुष्टेन भूयः कृष्णेन कारितः /
रथस्थो मथुराञ्चागात् कंसोक्ताक्रूरसंस्तुतः //
12.m: Being pleased, Kṛṣṇa again caused the festival of Indra to be performed. / Standing in a chariot, he went to Mathurā, praised by Akrūra who was commanded by Kaṃsa,

12.s:
gopībhiranuraktābhiḥ krīḍitābhir nirīkṣitaḥ /
:p 29
rajakaṃ cāprayacchantaṃ(1) hatvā vastrāṇi cāgrahīt //
12.d:
गोपीभिरनुरक्ताभिः क्रीडिताभिर् निरीक्षितः /
:प् 29
रजकं चाप्रयच्छन्तं(1) हत्वा वस्त्राणि चाग्रहीत् //
12.m:
gazed upon by the cowherd women, who were attached to him and had sporting amours with him.
[p. 29]
And having slain the washerman who refused [garments], he seized the clothes.

12.s:
saha rāmeṇa mālābhṛn mālākāre varandadau /
dattānulepanāṃ kubjām ṛjuṃ cakre 'hanad gajaṃ //
12.d:
सह रामेण मालाभृन् मालाकारे वरन्ददौ /
दत्तानुलेपनां कुब्जाम् ऋजुं चक्रे ऽहनद् गजं //
12.m: Along with Rāma, wearing garlands, he granted a boon to the garland-maker. / He straightened the hunchbacked woman who offered ointment, and he slew the elephant

12.s:
mattaṃ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ dvāri raṅgaṃ praviśya ca /
kaṃsādīnāṃ paśyatāṃ ca mañcasthānāṃ niyuddhakaṃ //
12.d:
मत्तं कुवलयापीडं द्वारि रङ्गं प्रविश्य च /
कंसादीनां पश्यतां च मञ्चस्थानां नियुद्धकं //
12.m: Kuvalayāpīḍa who was in rut at the gate. Entering the arena / while Kaṃsa and others seated upon the platform were watching, he engaged in close combat

12.s:
cakre cāṇūramallena muṣṭikena balo 'karot /
cāṇūramuṣṭikau tābhyāṃ hatau mallau tathāpare //
12.d:
चक्रे चाणूरमल्लेन मुष्टिकेन बलो ऽकरोत् /
चाणूरमुष्टिकौ ताभ्यां हतौ मल्लौ तथापरे //
12.m: with the wrestler Cāṇūra, while Bala fought with Muṣṭika. / The two wrestlers Cāṇūra and Muṣṭika were slain by them, and likewise others.

12.s:
mathurādhipatiṃ kaṃsaṃ hatvā tatpitaraṃ hariḥ /
cakre yādavarājānam astiprāptī ca kaṃsage //
12.d:
मथुराधिपतिं कंसं हत्वा तत्पितरं हरिः /
चक्रे यादवराजानम् अस्तिप्राप्ती च कंसगे //
12.m: Having slain Kaṃsa, the lord of Mathurā, Hari made / his father king of the Yādavas. Asti and Prāpti, wives of Kaṃsa,

12.s:
jarāsandhasya te putryau jarāsandhastadīritaḥ /
cakre sa mathurārodhaṃ yādavair yuyudhe śaraiḥ //
12.d:
जरासन्धस्य ते पुत्र्यौ जरासन्धस्तदीरितः /
चक्रे स मथुरारोधं यादवैर् युयुधे शरैः //
12.m: were the two daughters of Jarāsandha. Urged by them, Jarāsandha / laid siege to Mathurā and fought the Yādavas with arrows.

12.s:
rāmakṛṣṇau ca mathurāṃ tyaktvā gomantamāgatau /
jarāsandhaṃ vijityājau pauṇḍrakaṃ vāsudevakaṃ //
12.d:
रामकृष्णौ च मथुरां त्यक्त्वा गोमन्तमागतौ /
जरासन्धं विजित्याजौ पौण्ड्रकं वासुदेवकं //
12.m: Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, having left Mathurā, came to Mount Gomanta. / Having conquered Jarāsandha in battle, and Pauṇḍraka Vāsudeva,

12.s:
purīṃ ca dvārakāṃ kṛtvā nyavasad yādavair vṛtaḥ /
bhaumaṃ tu narakaṃ hatvā tenānītāś ca kanyakāḥ //
12.d:
पुरीं च द्वारकां कृत्वा न्यवसद् यादवैर् वृतः /
भौमं तु नरकं हत्वा तेनानीताश् च कन्यकाः //
12.m: and having built the city of Dvārakā, he dwelt there surrounded by the Yādavas. / Having slain the earth-born Naraka, [he took] the maidens brought by him

12.s:
devagandharvayakṣāṇāṃ tā uvāca janārdanaḥ /
ṣodaśastrīsahasrāṇi rukmiṇyādyās tathāṣṭa ca //
12.d:
देवगन्धर्वयक्षाणां ता उवाच जनार्दनः /
षोदशस्त्रीसहस्राणि रुक्मिण्याद्यास् तथाष्ट च //
12.m: from gods, gandharvas, and yakṣas; Janārdana addressed them. / There were sixteen thousand women, and eight [principal queens] headed by Rukmiṇī.

12.s:
satyabhāmāsamāyukto garuḍe narakārdanaḥ /
maṇiśailaṃ saratrañca indraṃ jitvā harirdivi //
12.d:
सत्यभामासमायुक्तो गरुडे नरकार्दनः /
मणिशैलं सरत्रञ्च इन्द्रं जित्वा हरिर्दिवि //
12.m: Mounted on Garuḍa together with Satyabhāmā, the destroyer of Naraka, / Hari, having conquered Indra in heaven, along with the jeweled mountain and gems,

12.s:
pārijātaṃ samānīya satyabhāmāgṛhe 'karot /
sāndīpaneś ca śastrāstraṃ jñātvā tadbālakaṃ dadau //
12.d:
पारिजातं समानीय सत्यभामागृहे ऽकरोत् /
सान्दीपनेश् च शस्त्रास्त्रं ज्ञात्वा तद्बालकं ददौ //
12.m: brought the Pārijāta tree and planted it in Satyabhāmā's house. / Having learned weapons and missiles from Sāndīpani, he returned his child [to him],

12.s:
jitvā pañcajanaṃ daityaṃ yamena ca supūjitaḥ /
:n
1 rajakañca prajalpantamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 30
abadhīt kālayavanaṃ mucukundena pūjitaḥ //
12.d:
जित्वा पञ्चजनं दैत्यं यमेन च सुपूजितः /
:न्
1 रजकञ्च प्रजल्पन्तमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 30
अबधीत् कालयवनं मुचुकुन्देन पूजितः //
12.m:
having conquered the Daitya Pañcajana, and was greatly honored by Yama.
[Footnote]
[Variant reading: 'rajakañca prajalpantam' in manuscript Kha] / [p. 30]
He had Kālayavana killed, and was honored by Mucukunda.

12.s:
vasudevaṃ devakīñca bhaktaviprāṃś ca sorcyat /
revatyāṃ balabhadrācca yajñāte niśaṭhonmukau //
12.d:
वसुदेवं देवकीञ्च भक्तविप्रांश् च सोर्च्यत् /
रेवत्यां बलभद्राच्च यज्ञाते निशठोन्मुकौ //
12.m: He honored Vasudeva, Devakī, and the devoted brāhmaṇas. / From Balabhadra through Revatī were born Niśaṭha and Ulmuka.

12.s: kṛṣṇāt śāmbo jāmbavatyāmanyāsvanye 'bhavan sutāḥ /
12.d: कृष्णात् शाम्बो जाम्बवत्यामन्यास्वन्ये ऽभवन् सुताः /
12.m: From Kṛṣṇa, Sāmba was born to Jāmbavatī, and other sons were born to other [wives].

12.s: taṃ matsyaṃ śambarāyādānmāyāvatyai ca śambaraḥ //
12.d: तं मत्स्यं शम्बरायादान्मायावत्यै च शम्बरः //
12.m: [The fisherman] gave that fish to Śambara, and Śambara gave it to Māyāvatī.

12.s:
māyāvatī matsyamadhye dṛṣṭvā svaṃ patimādarāt /
papoṣa sā taṃ covāca ratiste 'haṃ patirmama //
12.d:
मायावती मत्स्यमध्ये दृष्ट्वा स्वं पतिमादरात् /
पपोष सा तं चोवाच रतिस्ते ऽहं पतिर्मम //
12.m: Māyāvatī, seeing her own husband within the fish, eagerly / nurtured him and said to him: “I am Rati, and you are my husband.

12.s:
kāmastvaṃ śambhunānaṅgaḥ kṛtohaṃ śambareṇa ca /
hṛtā na tasya patnī tvaṃ māyājñaḥ śambaraṃ jahi //
12.d:
कामस्त्वं शम्भुनानङ्गः कृतोहं शम्बरेण च /
हृता न तस्य पत्नी त्वं मायाज्ञः शम्बरं जहि //
12.m: You are Kāma, made bodiless by Śambhu; and I was abducted / by Śambara, but I am not his wife. You who know illusions, slay Śambara!”

12.s:
tac chrutvā śambaraṃ hatvā pradyumnaḥ saha bhāryayā /
māyāvatyā yayau kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇo hṛṣṭo 'tha rukmiṇī //
12.d:
तच् छ्रुत्वा शम्बरं हत्वा प्रद्युम्नः सह भार्यया /
मायावत्या ययौ कृष्णं कृष्णो हृष्टो ऽथ रुक्मिणी //
12.m: Having heard that, and having slain Śambara, Pradyumna went to Kṛṣṇa / along with his wife Māyāvatī; Kṛṣṇa and Rukmiṇī were delighted.

12.s:
pradyumnādaniruddhobhūduṣāpatirudāradhīḥ /
bāṇo balisutastasya sutoṣā śoṇitaṃ puraṃ //
12.d:
प्रद्युम्नादनिरुद्धोभूदुषापतिरुदारधीः /
बाणो बलिसुतस्तस्य सुतोषा शोणितं पुरं //
12.m: From Pradyumna was born the noble-minded Aniruddha, husband of Uṣā. / Bāṇa was the son of Bali, his daughter was Uṣā, and his city was Śoṇitapura.

12.s:
tapasā śivaputro 'bhūt māyūradhvajapātitaḥ /
yuddhaṃ prāpsyasi vāṇa tvaṃ vāṇaṃ tuṣṭaḥ śivobhyadhāt //
12.d:
तपसा शिवपुत्रो ऽभूत् मायूरध्वजपातितः /
युद्धं प्राप्स्यसि वाण त्वं वाणं तुष्टः शिवोभ्यधात् //
12.m: Through ascetic austerity, he became a son of Śiva, having his banner fallen from the peacock. / Śiva, being pleased, said to Bāṇa: “You shall obtain battle, O Bāṇa.”

12.s:
śivena krīḍatīṃ gaurīṃ dṛṣṭvoṣā saspṛhā patau /
tāmāha gaurī bhartā te niśi supteti darśanāt //
12.d:
शिवेन क्रीडतीं गौरीं दृष्ट्वोषा सस्पृहा पतौ /
तामाह गौरी भर्ता ते निशि सुप्तेति दर्शनात् //
12.m: Uṣā, having seen Gaurī sporting with Śiva, felt longing for a husband. / Gaurī said to her: “Your husband, seen while sleeping at night,

12.s:
vaiśākhamāsadvādaśyāṃ puṃso bhartā bhaviṣyati /
gauryuktā(1) harṣitā coṣā gṛhe suptā dadarśa taṃ //
12.d:
वैशाखमासद्वादश्यां पुंसो भर्ता भविष्यति /
गौर्युक्ता(1) हर्षिता चोषा गृहे सुप्ता ददर्श तं //
12.m: shall become your husband among men on the twelfth lunar day of the month of Vaiśākha.” / Addressed by Gaurī, Uṣā was overjoyed and saw him while sleeping in her chamber.

12.s:
ātmanā saṅgataṃ jñātvā tatsakhyā citralekhayā /
likhitādvai citrapaṭādaniruddhaṃ samānayat //
:n
1 tac chrutvā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 31
12.d:
आत्मना सङ्गतं ज्ञात्वा तत्सख्या चित्रलेखया /
लिखिताद्वै चित्रपटादनिरुद्धं समानयत् //
:न्
1 तच् छ्रुत्वा इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 31
12.m:
Knowing him to have united with her, through her friend Citralekhā / who drew pictures on a canvas, she brought Aniruddha
[Footnote]
[Variant reading: 'tac chrutvā' in manuscript Ga] / [p. 31]

12.s:
kṛṣṇapautraṃ dvārakāto duhitā vāṇamantriṇaḥ /
kumbhāṇḍasyāniruddhogādrarāma hy uṣayā saha //
12.d:
कृष्णपौत्रं द्वारकातो दुहिता वाणमन्त्रिणः /
कुम्भाण्डस्यानिरुद्धोगाद्रराम ह्य् उषया सह //
12.m: from Dvārakā, the grandson of Kṛṣṇa, through the daughter of Bāṇa's minister, / Kumbhāṇḍa. Aniruddha arrived and sported indeed with Uṣā.

12.s:
vāṇadhvajasya sampātai rakṣibhiḥ sa niveditaḥ /
aniruddhasya vāṇena yuddhamāsītsadāruṇam //
12.d:
वाणध्वजस्य सम्पातै रक्षिभिः स निवेदितः /
अनिरुद्धस्य वाणेन युद्धमासीत्सदारुणम् //
12.m: He was reported by the guards due to the falling of Bāṇa's banner. / A fierce battle ensued between Aniruddha and Bāṇa.

12.s:
śrutvā tu nāradāt kṛṣṇaḥ pradyumnabalabhadravān /
garuḍasthotha jitvāgnīn jvaraṃ māheśvarantathā //
12.d:
श्रुत्वा तु नारदात् कृष्णः प्रद्युम्नबलभद्रवान् /
गरुडस्थोथ जित्वाग्नीन् ज्वरं माहेश्वरन्तथा //
12.m: Having heard this from Nārada, Kṛṣṇa, accompanied by Pradyumna and Balabhadra, / mounted on Garuḍa, then conquered the fires and likewise the fever of Maheśvara.

12.s:
hariśaṅkarayoryuddhaṃ babhūvātha śarāśari /
nandivināyakaskandamukhāstārkṣādibhirjitāḥ //
12.d:
हरिशङ्करयोर्युद्धं बभूवाथ शराशरि /
नन्दिविनायकस्कन्दमुखास्तार्क्षादिभिर्जिताः //
12.m: Then there was a battle with showers of arrows between Hari and Śaṅkara. / Nandin, Vināyaka, Skanda, and the other chiefs were defeated by Garuḍa and the rest.

12.s:
jṛmbhate śaṅkare naṣṭe jṛmbhaṇāstreṇa viṣṇunā /
chinnaṃ sahasraṃ bāhūnāṃ rudreṇābhayamarthitam //
12.d:
जृम्भते शङ्करे नष्टे जृम्भणास्त्रेण विष्णुना /
छिन्नं सहस्रं बाहूनां रुद्रेणाभयमर्थितम् //
12.m: When Śaṅkara was yawning and subdued by Viṣṇu using the yawning weapon, / a thousand arms [of Bāṇa] were severed; Rudra pleaded for safety [for him].

12.s:
viṣṇunā jīvito vāṇo dvibāhuḥ prābravīcchivam /
tvayā yadabhayaṃ dattaṃ vāṇasyāsya mayā ca tat //
12.d:
विष्णुना जीवितो वाणो द्विबाहुः प्राब्रवीच्छिवम् /
त्वया यदभयं दत्तं वाणस्यास्य मया च तत् //
12.m: Kept alive by Viṣṇu, two-armed Bāṇa addressed Śiva: / “The safety granted by you to this Bāṇa is also granted by me.

12.s:
āvayor nāsti bhedo vai bhedī narakamāpnuyāt /
śivādyaiḥ pūjito viṣṇuḥ soniruddha uṣādiyuk //
12.d:
आवयोर् नास्ति भेदो वै भेदी नरकमाप्नुयात् /
शिवाद्यैः पूजितो विष्णुः सोनिरुद्ध उषादियुक् //
12.m: There is truly no difference between the two of us; whoever sees difference goes to hell.” / Viṣṇu, honored by Śiva and others, along with Aniruddha, Uṣā, and the rest,

12.s:
dvārakāntu gato reme ugrasenādiyādavaiḥ /
aniruddhātmajo vajro mārkaṇḍeyāttu sarvavit //
12.d:
द्वारकान्तु गतो रेमे उग्रसेनादियादवैः /
अनिरुद्धात्मजो वज्रो मार्कण्डेयात्तु सर्ववित् //
12.m: went to Dvārakā and rejoiced with Ugrasena and the other Yādavas. / The son of Aniruddha was Vajra, who learned all from Mārkaṇḍeya.

12.s:
balabhadraḥ pralambaghno yamunākarṣaṇo(1) 'bhavat /
dvividasya kaperbhettā kauravonmādanāśanaḥ //
12.d:
बलभद्रः प्रलम्बघ्नो यमुनाकर्षणो(1) ऽभवत् /
द्विविदस्य कपेर्भेत्ता कौरवोन्मादनाशनः //
12.m: Balabhadra became the slayer of Pralamba, the dragger of the Yamunā, / the killer of the monkey Dvivida, and the destroyer of the arrogance of the Kauravas.

12.s:
harī remenekamūrto rukmiṇyādibhirīśvaraḥ /
putrānutpādayāmāsa tvasaṃkhyātān sa yādavān /
harivaṃśaṃ paṭhet yaḥ sa prāptakāmo hariṃ vrajet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye harivaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo
'dhyāyaḥ
:n
1 karṣaka iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 32
:ś atha trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
kurupāṇḍavotpattyādikathanaṃ
12.d:
हरी रेमेनेकमूर्तो रुक्मिण्यादिभिरीश्वरः /
पुत्रानुत्पादयामास त्वसंख्यातान् स यादवान् /
हरिवंशं पठेत् यः स प्राप्तकामो हरिं व्रजेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये हरिवंशवर्णनं नाम द्वादशो
ऽध्यायः
:न्
1 कर्षक इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 32
:श् अथ त्रयोदशो ऽध्यायः
कुरुपाण्डवोत्पत्त्यादिकथनं
12.m:
Thus in the venerable and primordial Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni, the twelfth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Harivaṃśa'.
Thus ends the twelfth chapter, named The Description of the Harivaṃśa, in the glorious and ancient Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
[Variant note on verse 12.54:] 'karṣakaḥ' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [Page 32]
% Chapter 13
The narration of the origin of the Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas and other matters
Agni said: / I will fully declare the Bhārata, characterised by the majesty of Kṛṣṇa, / [wherein] Viṣṇu relieved the burden of the earth using the Pāṇḍavas as his instrument.

13.s:
agnir uvāca
bhārataṃ sampravakṣyāmi kṛṣṇamāhātmyalakṣaṇam /
bhūbhāramaharadviṣṇur nimittīkṛtya pāṇḍavān //
13.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
भारतं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि कृष्णमाहात्म्यलक्षणम् /
भूभारमहरद्विष्णुर् निमित्तीकृत्य पाण्डवान् //
13.m: Brahmā was born from the lotus in Viṣṇu's navel; Brahmā's son was Atri; from Atri / [came] Soma; from Soma came Budha; from him was Aila Purūravas.

13.s:
viṣṇunābhyabjajo brahmā brahmaputro 'triratritaḥ /
somaḥ somādbudhastasmādaila āsīt purūravāḥ //
13.d:
विष्णुनाभ्यब्जजो ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मपुत्रो ऽत्रिरत्रितः /
सोमः सोमाद्बुधस्तस्मादैल आसीत् पुरूरवाः //
13.m: From him [came] Āyu; from him King Nahuṣa; from him came Yayāti; / from him Puru; in his lineage [was] Bharata; then King Kuru.

13.s:
tasmādāyustato rājā nahuṣo 'to yayātikaḥ /
tataḥ purustasya vaṃśe bharato 'tha nṛpaḥ kuruḥ //
13.d:
तस्मादायुस्ततो राजा नहुषो ऽतो ययातिकः /
ततः पुरुस्तस्य वंशे भरतो ऽथ नृपः कुरुः //
13.m: In his lineage was Śāntanu; from him was Bhīṣma, the son of Gaṅgā; and his two younger brothers, / Citrāṅgada and Vicitravīrya, [born] of Satyavatī and Śāntanu.

13.s:
tadvaṃśe śāntanustasmādbhīṣmo gaṅgāsuto 'nujau /
citrāṅgado vicitraś ca satyavayāñca śāntanoḥ //
13.d:
तद्वंशे शान्तनुस्तस्माद्भीष्मो गङ्गासुतो ऽनुजौ /
चित्राङ्गदो विचित्रश् च सत्यवयाञ्च शान्तनोः //
13.m: And when Śāntanu went to heaven, Bhīṣma, renouncing a wife, / protected his brother's realm, [for] young Citrāṅgada was slain.

13.s:
svargaṃ gate śāntanau ca bhīṣmo bhāryāvivarjitaḥ /
apālayat bhrātṛrājyaṃ bālaścitrāṅgado hataḥ //
13.d:
स्वर्गं गते शान्तनौ च भीष्मो भार्याविवर्जितः /
अपालयत् भ्रातृराज्यं बालश्चित्राङ्गदो हतः //
13.m: Two daughters of the king of Kāśi, Ambikā / and Ambālikā, were brought by Bhīṣma, conqueror of enemies, for Citrāṅgada's [brother].

13.s:
citrāṅgadena dve kanye kāśirājasya cāmbikā /
ambālikā ca bhīṣmeṇa ānīte vijitāriṇā //
13.d:
चित्राङ्गदेन द्वे कन्ये काशिराजस्य चाम्बिका /
अम्बालिका च भीष्मेण आनीते विजितारिणा //
13.m: [They became] the two wives of Vicitravīrya; he passed to heaven from consumption. / By Satyavatī's consent, from Ambikā was born the king,

13.s:
bhārye vicitravīryasya yakṣmaṇā sa divaṅgataḥ /
satyavatyā hy anumatādambikāyāṃ nṛpobhavat //
13.d:
भार्ये विचित्रवीर्यस्य यक्ष्मणा स दिवङ्गतः /
सत्यवत्या ह्य् अनुमतादम्बिकायां नृपोभवत् //
13.m: Dhṛtarāṣṭra; and from Ambālikā the son Pāṇḍu, through Vyāsa. / From Dhṛtarāṣṭra, on Gāndhārī, [were born] a hundred sons headed by Duryodhana.

13.s:
dhṛtarāṣṭro 'mbālikāyāṃ pāṇḍuś ca vyāsataḥ sutaḥ /
gāndhāryāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrācca duryodhanamukhaṃ śatam //
13.d:
धृतराष्ट्रो ऽम्बालिकायां पाण्डुश् च व्यासतः सुतः /
गान्धार्यां धृतराष्ट्राच्च दुर्योधनमुखं शतम् //
13.m: At the hermitage of Śataśṛṅga, since [his] death was destined from union with a wife / due to a sage's curse, Yudhiṣṭhira was born to Pāṇḍu from Dharma on Kuntī.

13.s:
śataśṛṅgāśramapade bhāryāyogād yato mṛtiḥ /
ṛṣiśāpāttato dharmāt kuntyāṃ pāṇḍoryudhiṣṭhiraḥ //
13.d:
शतशृङ्गाश्रमपदे भार्यायोगाद् यतो मृतिः /
ऋषिशापात्ततो धर्मात् कुन्त्यां पाण्डोर्युधिष्ठिरः //
13.m: From Vāta [was born] Bhīma; Arjuna from Śakra; on Mādrī, from the two Aśvins, / [were born] Nakula and Sahadeva; Pāṇḍu died united with Mādrī.

13.s:
vātādbhīmo 'rjunaḥ śakrānmādryāmaśvikumārataḥ /
nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca pāṇḍurmādrīyuto mṛtaḥ //
13.d:
वाताद्भीमो ऽर्जुनः शक्रान्माद्र्यामश्विकुमारतः /
नकुलः सहदेवश् च पाण्डुर्माद्रीयुतो मृतः //
13.m: Karṇa was born to Kuntī when she was an unmarried maiden; he took refuge with Duryodhana. / Enmity arose indeed between the Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas by the decree of fate.

13.s:
karṇaḥ kuntyāṃ hi kanyāyāṃ jāto duryodhāśritaḥ /
kurupāṇḍavayorvairandaivayogādbabhūva ha //
:p 33
13.d:
कर्णः कुन्त्यां हि कन्यायां जातो दुर्योधाश्रितः /
कुरुपाण्डवयोर्वैरन्दैवयोगाद्बभूव ह //
:प् 33
13.m:
[Page 33]
The evil-minded Duryodhana burned the Pāṇḍavas in the house of lac; / but the Pāṇḍavas escaped from the burning house, their mother behind them.

13.s:
duryodhano jatugṛhe pāṇḍavānadahat kudhīḥ /
dagdhāgārādviniṣkrāntā mātṛpṛṣṭāstu pāṇḍavāḥ //
13.d:
दुर्योधनो जतुगृहे पाण्डवानदहत् कुधीः /
दग्धागाराद्विनिष्क्रान्ता मातृपृष्टास्तु पाण्डवाः //
13.m: Then in Ekacakrā, in the dwelling of a brāhmaṇa, / they all stayed disguised as ascetics, having slain the rākṣasa Vaka.

13.s:
tatastu ekacakrāyāṃ brāhmaṇasya niveśane /
muniveṣāḥ sthitāḥ sarve nihatya vakarākṣasam //
13.d:
ततस्तु एकचक्रायां ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने /
मुनिवेषाः स्थिताः सर्वे निहत्य वकराक्षसम् //
13.m: They went to the Pāñcāla region; at Draupadī's svayaṃvara, / Draupadī was won by the five Pāṇḍavas through shooting the target.

13.s:
yayauḥ pāñcālaviṣayaṃ draupadyāste svayamvare /
samprāptā bāhuvedhena(1) draupadī pañcapāṇḍavaiḥ(2) //
13.d:
ययौः पाञ्चालविषयं द्रौपद्यास्ते स्वयम्वरे /
सम्प्राप्ता बाहुवेधेन(1) द्रौपदी पञ्चपाण्डवैः(2) //
13.m: Then, recognised by Duryodhana and the others, they received half the kingdom, / and [Arjuna received] the divine bow Gāṇḍīva and an excellent chariot from the Fire-god,

13.s:
ardharājyaṃ tataḥ prāptā jñātā duryodhanādibhiḥ /
gāṇḍīvañca dhanurdivyaṃ pāvakādrathamuttamam //
13.d:
अर्धराज्यं ततः प्राप्ता ज्ञाता दुर्योधनादिभिः /
गाण्डीवञ्च धनुर्दिव्यं पावकाद्रथमुत्तमम् //
13.m: and Kṛṣṇa as his charioteer in battle, inexhaustible arrows, / and the Brahmāstra and other [weapons] from Droṇa; they all became skilled in arms.

13.s:
sārathiñcārjunaḥ saṅkhye kṛṣṇamakṣayyaśāyakān /
brahmāstrādīṃs tathā droṇātsarve śastraviśāradāḥ //
13.d:
सारथिञ्चार्जुनः सङ्ख्ये कृष्णमक्षय्यशायकान् /
ब्रह्मास्त्रादींस् तथा द्रोणात्सर्वे शस्त्रविशारदाः //
13.m: Together with Kṛṣṇa, that Arjuna fully satiated the Fire-god in Khāṇḍava, / the Pāṇḍava warding off Indra's downpour with a shower of arrows.

13.s:
kṛṣṇena so 'rjuno vahniṃ khāṇḍave samatarpayat /
indravṛṣṭiṃ vārayaṃś ca śaravarṣeṇa pāṇḍavaḥ //
13.d:
कृष्णेन सो ऽर्जुनो वह्निं खाण्डवे समतर्पयत् /
इन्द्रवृष्टिं वारयंश् च शरवर्षेण पाण्डवः //
13.m: The quarters were conquered by the Pāṇḍavas, and Yudhiṣṭhira ruled the kingdom; / he [performed] the Rājasūya sacrifice with abundant gold; Suyodhana could not endure it.

13.s:
jitā diśaḥ pāṇḍavaiś ca rājyañcakre yudhiṣṭhiraḥ /
bahusvarṇaṃ(3) rājasūyaṃ na sehe taṃ suyodhanaḥ //
13.d:
जिता दिशः पाण्डवैश् च राज्यञ्चक्रे युधिष्ठिरः /
बहुस्वर्णं(3) राजसूयं न सेहे तं सुयोधनः //
13.m: Urged by his brother Duḥśāsana and by Karṇa, who had gained prosperity, / and with Śakuni acting in the gambling match, through dice he [conquered] Yudhiṣṭhira.

13.s:
bhrātrā duḥśāsanenoktaḥ karṇena prāptabhūtinā /
dyūtakārye śakuninā dyūtena sa yudhiṣṭhiram //
13.d:
भ्रात्रा दुःशासनेनोक्तः कर्णेन प्राप्तभूतिना /
द्यूतकार्ये शकुनिना द्यूतेन स युधिष्ठिरम् //
13.m: He won his kingdom, and standing in the assembly, he laughed maliciously. / Defeated, Yudhiṣṭhira went to the forest accompanied by his brothers.

13.s:
ajayattasya rājyañca sabhāstho māyayāhasat /
jito yudhiṣṭhiro bhrātṛyuktaścāraṇyakaṃ yayau //
13.d:
अजयत्तस्य राज्यञ्च सभास्थो माययाहसत् /
जितो युधिष्ठिरो भ्रातृयुक्तश्चारण्यकं ययौ //
13.m: He spent the twelve years in the forest as promised, / feeding eighty-eight thousand twice-born as before.

13.s:
vane dvādaśavarṣāṇi pratijñātāni so 'nayat /
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi bhojayan pūrvavat dvijān //
13.d:
वने द्वादशवर्षाणि प्रतिज्ञातानि सो ऽनयत् /
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि भोजयन् पूर्ववत् द्विजान् //
13.m: With Dhaumya, and with Draupadī as the sixth, the king went to the court of Virāṭa; / [Yudhiṣṭhira was] Kaṅka, an unknown brāhmaṇa, and Bhīma became the cook.

13.s:
sadhaumyo draupadīṣaṣṭhastataḥ prāyādvirāṭakam /
kaṅko dvijo hy avijñāto(4) rājā bhīmotha sūpakṛt //
:n
1 bāhubhedena iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 draupadīṃ pañca pāṇḍavā iti kha, ga, ṅa,
cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
3 vasupūrṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ ratnapūrṇamiti gha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 kaṅko dvijo hy abhūcchreṣṭha iti kha,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 34
13.d:
सधौम्यो द्रौपदीषष्ठस्ततः प्रायाद्विराटकम् /
कङ्को द्विजो ह्य् अविज्ञातो(4) राजा भीमोथ सूपकृत् //
:न्
1 बाहुभेदेन इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 द्रौपदीं पञ्च पाण्डवा इति ख, ग, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
3 वसुपूर्णमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः रत्नपूर्णमिति घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 कङ्को द्विजो ह्य् अभूच्छ्रेष्ठ इति ख,चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 34
13.m:
With Dhaumya, and Draupadī as the sixth, he then set out for Virāṭa's realm. / [Yudhiṣṭhira became] the twice-born Kaṅka, unknown, a king; then Bhīma, a cook.
[Variant note on verse 13.22:] 'bāhubhedena' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
[Variant note on verse 13.22:] 'draupadīṃ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ' is the reading in the three manuscripts marked kha, ga, and ṅa.
[Variant note on verse 13.26:] 'vasupūrṇam' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; 'ratnapūrṇam' is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
[Variant note on verse 13.30:] 'kaṅko dvijo hy abhūcchreṣṭhaḥ' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [Page 34]
Arjuna became Bṛhannalā; the wife [became] Sairindhrī; likewise the twins / [took] other names; and Bhīmasena slew Kīcaka by night,

13.s:
bṛhannalārjuno bhāryā sairindhrī yamajau tathā /
anyanāmnā bhīmasenaḥ kīcakañcābadhīnniśi //
13.d:
बृहन्नलार्जुनो भार्या सैरिन्ध्री यमजौ तथा /
अन्यनाम्ना भीमसेनः कीचकञ्चाबधीन्निशि //
13.m: who wished to abduct Draupadī; and Arjuna defeated the Kurus / who were seizing cattle and other [wealth]; then the Pāṇḍavas were recognised by them.

13.s:
draupadīṃ hartukāmaṃ taṃ arjunaścājayat kurūn /
kurvato gograhādīṃś ca tair jñātāḥ pāṇḍavā atha //
13.d:
द्रौपदीं हर्तुकामं तं अर्जुनश्चाजयत् कुरून् /
कुर्वतो गोग्रहादींश् च तैर् ज्ञाताः पाण्डवा अथ //
13.m: Subhadrā, the sister of Kṛṣṇa, gave birth from Arjuna / to Abhimanyu; and Virāṭa gave [him] his daughter Uttarā.

13.s:
subhadrā kṛṣṇabhaginī arjunātsamajījanat /
abhimanyundadau tasmai virāṭaścottarāṃ sutām //
13.d:
सुभद्रा कृष्णभगिनी अर्जुनात्समजीजनत् /
अभिमन्युन्ददौ तस्मै विराटश्चोत्तरां सुताम् //
13.m: Dharmarāja became the commander of seven akṣauhiṇīs for the battle. / Kṛṣṇa went as an envoy and spoke to the impatient Duryodhana,

13.s:
saptākṣauhiṇīśa āsīddharmarājo raṇāya saḥ /
kṛṣṇo dūtobravīd gatvā duryodhanamamarṣaṇam //
13.d:
सप्ताक्षौहिणीश आसीद्धर्मराजो रणाय सः /
कृष्णो दूतोब्रवीद् गत्वा दुर्योधनममर्षणम् //
13.m: King Duryodhana, who was then the commander of eleven akṣauhiṇīs: / 'Give half the kingdom to Yudhiṣṭhira, or five villages;

13.s:
ekādaśākṣauhiṇīśaṃ nṛpaṃ duryodhanaṃ tadā /
yudhiṣṭhirāyārdharājyaṃ dehi grāmāṃś ca pañca vā //
13.d:
एकादशाक्षौहिणीशं नृपं दुर्योधनं तदा /
युधिष्ठिरायार्धराज्यं देहि ग्रामांश् च पञ्च वा //
13.m: or else fight!' Having heard his words, Suyodhana said to Kṛṣṇa: / 'I will not give even the tip of a needle of land; determined to fight, I shall wage war.'

13.s:
yudhyasva vā vacaḥ śrutvā kṛṣṇamāha suyodhanaḥ /
bhūsūcyagraṃ na dāsyāmi yotsye saṅgrahaṇodyataḥ //
13.d:
युध्यस्व वा वचः श्रुत्वा कृष्णमाह सुयोधनः /
भूसूच्यग्रं न दास्यामि योत्स्ये सङ्ग्रहणोद्यतः //
13.m: Having displayed his unassailable cosmic form, revered by Vidura, / [Kṛṣṇa] went away, and said to Yudhiṣṭhira: 'Make war upon this Suyodhana.'

13.s:
viśvarūpandarśayitvā adhṛṣyaṃ vidurārcitaḥ(1) /
prāgādyudhiṣṭhiraṃ prāha yodhayainaṃ suyodhanam //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye ādiparvādivarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
kurupāṇḍavasaṅgrāmavarṇanam
13.d:
विश्वरूपन्दर्शयित्वा अधृष्यं विदुरार्चितः(1) /
प्रागाद्युधिष्ठिरं प्राह योधयैनं सुयोधनम् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये आदिपर्वादिवर्णनं नाम त्रयोदशो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ चतुर्दशो ऽध्यायः
कुरुपाण्डवसङ्ग्रामवर्णनम्
13.m:
Thus in the venerable and primordial Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni, the thirteenth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Ādiparvan and Following Books'.
% Chapter 14
The description of the battle between the Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas
Agni said: / Yudhiṣṭhira's army and Duryodhana's army marched to Kurukṣetra. / Seeing Bhīṣma, Droṇa, and the others, [Arjuna] did not fight, thinking them to be his elders.

14.s:
agnir uvāca
yaudhiṣṭhirī dauryodhanī kurukṣetraṃ yayau camūḥ /
bhīṣmadroṇādikān dṛṣṭvā nāyudhyata gurūniti //
14.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
यौधिष्ठिरी दौर्योधनी कुरुक्षेत्रं ययौ चमूः /
भीष्मद्रोणादिकान् दृष्ट्वा नायुध्यत गुरूनिति //
14.m: The Blessed One said to Pārtha: 'Bhīṣma and the other chiefs are not to be grieved for. / Bodies perish; the embodied [self] does not perish.

14.s:
pārthaṃ hy uvāca bhagavānnaśocyā bhīṣmamukhyakāḥ /
śarīrāṇi vināśīni na śarīrī vinaśyati //
:n
1 vidurānvita iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 35
14.d:
पार्थं ह्य् उवाच भगवान्नशोच्या भीष्ममुख्यकाः /
शरीराणि विनाशीनि न शरीरी विनश्यति //
:न्
1 विदुरान्वित इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 35
14.m:
The Blessed Lord said to Pārtha: “Bhīṣma and the other leaders are not to be grieved for. / Bodies perish; the embodied self does not perish.
[Variant note on verse 13.42:] 'vidurānvitaḥ' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [Page 35]
Know this self to be the supreme Brahman: "I am Brahman." / A yogin, impartial in success and failure, protect the duty of kings!'

14.s:
ayamātmā paraṃ brahma ahaṃ brahmasmi viddhi tam /
siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo yogī rājadharmaṃ prapālaya //
14.d:
अयमात्मा परं ब्रह्म अहं ब्रह्मस्मि विद्धि तम् /
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो योगी राजधर्मं प्रपालय //
14.m: Addressed thus by Kṛṣṇa, Arjuna, standing on his chariot accompanied by the blare of musical instruments, fought. / Bhīṣma was the general at first in Duryodhana's force,

14.s:
kṛṣṇoktothārjuno 'yudhyadrathastho vādyaśabdavān /
bhīṣmaḥ senāpatirabhūdādau dauryodhane bale //
14.d:
कृष्णोक्तोथार्जुनो ऽयुध्यद्रथस्थो वाद्यशब्दवान् /
भीष्मः सेनापतिरभूदादौ दौर्योधने बले //
14.m: and Śikhaṇḍī for the Pāṇḍavas; and a battle took place between the two. / The sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra together with Bhīṣma struck the Pāṇḍavas in battle,

14.s:
pāṇḍavānāṃ śikhaṇḍī ca tayoryuddhaṃ babhūva ha /
dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ pāṇḍavāṃś ca jaghnuryuddhe sabhīṣmakāḥ //
14.d:
पाण्डवानां शिखण्डी च तयोर्युद्धं बभूव ह /
धार्तराष्ट्राः पाण्डवांश् च जघ्नुर्युद्धे सभीष्मकाः //
14.m: and the Pāṇḍavas headed by Śikhaṇḍī struck the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra in the encounter. / The battle between the armies of the Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas was like that between gods and asuras,

14.s:
dhārtarāṣṭrān śikhaṇḍyādyāḥ pāṇḍavā jaghnurāhave /
devāsurasaṃ yuddhaṃ kurupāṇdavasenayoḥ //
14.d:
धार्तराष्ट्रान् शिखण्ड्याद्याः पाण्डवा जघ्नुराहवे /
देवासुरसं युद्धं कुरुपाण्दवसेनयोः //
14.m: increasing the delight of the serene gods who were watching. / In ten days Bhīṣma struck down the Pāṇḍava army with divine weapons.

14.s:
babhūva svasthadevānāṃ paśyatāṃ prītivardhanaṃ /
bhīṣmostraiḥ pāṇḍavaṃ sainyaṃ daśāhobhirnyapātayat //
14.d:
बभूव स्वस्थदेवानां पश्यतां प्रीतिवर्धनं /
भीष्मोस्त्रैः पाण्डवं सैन्यं दशाहोभिर्न्यपातयत् //
14.m: On the tenth day Arjuna rained arrows upon the heroic Bhīṣma; / Śikhaṇḍī, urged by Drupada, showered him with weapons like a cloud.

14.s:
daśame hy arjuno vāṇair bhīṣmaṃ vīraṃ vavarṣa ha /
śikhaṇḍī drupadokto 'strair vavarṣa jalado yathā //
14.d:
दशमे ह्य् अर्जुनो वाणैर् भीष्मं वीरं ववर्ष ह /
शिखण्डी द्रुपदोक्तो ऽस्त्रैर् ववर्ष जलदो यथा //
14.m: Elephants, horses, chariots, and foot-soldiers were brought down by one another's weapons. / Bhīṣma, who had death at his own will, having shown the course of combat,

14.s:
hastyaśvarathapādātamanyonyāstranipātitam(1) /
bhīṣmaḥ svacchandamṛtyuś ca yuddhamārgaṃ pradarśya ca //
14.d:
हस्त्यश्वरथपादातमन्योन्यास्त्रनिपातितम्(1) /
भीष्मः स्वच्छन्दमृत्युश् च युद्धमार्गं प्रदर्श्य च //
14.m: Elephants, horses, chariots, and foot-soldiers were struck down by one another's weapons. / Bhīṣma, possessing death at his own will, having demonstrated the path of war,

14.s:
vasūkto vasulokāya śaraśayyāgataḥ sthitaḥ /
uttarāyaṇamīkṣaṃś ca dhyāyan viṣṇuṃ stavan sthitaḥ //
14.d:
वसूक्तो वसुलोकाय शरशय्यागतः स्थितः /
उत्तरायणमीक्षंश् च ध्यायन् विष्णुं स्तवन् स्थितः //
14.m: destined for the realm of the Vasus as spoken by the Vasus, lay resting on a bed of arrows. / Awaiting the northward course of the sun, he remained meditating on Viṣṇu and praising [him].

14.s:
duryodhane tu śokārte droṇaḥ senāpatistvabhut /
pāṇdave harṣite sainye ḍhṛṣṭadyumnaś camūpatiḥ //
14.d:
दुर्योधने तु शोकार्ते द्रोणः सेनापतिस्त्वभुत् /
पाण्दवे हर्षिते सैन्ये ढृष्टद्युम्नश् चमूपतिः //
14.m: When Duryodhana was stricken with grief, Droṇa became commander of the army; / in the Pandava army, filled with joy, Dhṛṣṭadyumna was the general.

14.s:
tayoryuddhaṃ babhūvograṃ yamarāṣṭravivardhanam /
virāṭadrupadādyāś ca nimagnā droṇasāgare //
14.d:
तयोर्युद्धं बभूवोग्रं यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम् /
विराटद्रुपदाद्याश् च निमग्ना द्रोणसागरे //
14.m: A fierce battle took place between the two, expanding the realm of Yama. / Virāṭa, Drupada, and others sank into the ocean of Droṇa.

14.s:
dauryodhanī mahāsenā hastyaśvarathapattinī /
dhṛṣṭadyumnādhipatitā droṇaḥ kāla ivābabhau //
14.d:
दौर्योधनी महासेना हस्त्यश्वरथपत्तिनी /
धृष्टद्युम्नाधिपतिता द्रोणः काल इवाबभौ //
14.m: Duryodhana's vast host of elephants, horses, chariots, and foot-soldiers / fell upon Dhṛṣṭadyumna, and Droṇa shone forth like Death.

14.s:
hatośvatthāmā cetyukte droṇaḥ śastrāṇi cātyajat /
dhṛṣṭadyumnaśarākrāntaḥ patitaḥ sa mahītale //
:n
1 anyonyāstranipīḍitamiti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 36
14.d:
हतोश्वत्थामा चेत्युक्ते द्रोणः शस्त्राणि चात्यजत् /
धृष्टद्युम्नशराक्रान्तः पतितः स महीतले //
:न्
1 अन्योन्यास्त्रनिपीडितमिति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 36
14.m:
When it was said, “Aśvatthāman is killed,” Droṇa laid aside his weapons; / overcome by Dhṛṣṭadyumna's arrows, he fell to the surface of the earth.
:n
1 The reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and gha is anyonyāstranipīḍitam.
:p 36

14.s:
pañcamehani durdharṣaḥ sarvakṣatraṃ pramathya ca /
duryodhane tu śokārte karṇaḥ senāpatistvabhūt //
14.d:
पञ्चमेहनि दुर्धर्षः सर्वक्षत्रं प्रमथ्य च /
दुर्योधने तु शोकार्ते कर्णः सेनापतिस्त्वभूत् //
14.m: On the fifth day, the unassailable [Droṇa], having crushed all the kṣatriyas [fell]. / And when Duryodhana was stricken with grief, Karṇa became commander of the army.

14.s:
arjunaḥ pāṇḍavānāñca tayoryuddhaṃ babhūva ha /
śastrāśastri mahāraudraṃ devāsuraraṇopamam //
14.d:
अर्जुनः पाण्डवानाञ्च तयोर्युद्धं बभूव ह /
शस्त्राशस्त्रि महारौद्रं देवासुररणोपमम् //
14.m: Arjuna [was commander] of the Pāṇḍavas, and a battle took place between the two: / weapon against weapon, exceedingly dreadful, resembling the war between the gods and asuras.

14.s:
karṇārjunākhye saṅgrāme karṇorīnabadhīccharaiḥ /
dvitīyāhani karṇastu arjunena nipātitaḥ //
14.d:
कर्णार्जुनाख्ये सङ्ग्रामे कर्णोरीनबधीच्छरैः /
द्वितीयाहनि कर्णस्तु अर्जुनेन निपातितः //
14.m: In the battle known as that of Karṇa and Arjuna, Karṇa slew his enemies with arrows; / but on the second day, Karṇa was felled by Arjuna.

14.s:
śalyo dinārdhaṃ yuyudhe hy abadhīttaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ /
yuyudhe bhīmasenena hatasainyaḥ suyodhanaḥ //
14.d:
शल्यो दिनार्धं युयुधे ह्य् अबधीत्तं युधिष्ठिरः /
युयुधे भीमसेनेन हतसैन्यः सुयोधनः //
14.m: Śalya fought for half a day, and Yudhiṣṭhira killed him. / His army slain, Suyodhana fought with Bhīmasena.

14.s:
bahūn hatvā narādīṃś ca bhīmasenamathābravīt /
gadayā praharantaṃ tu bhīmastantu vyapātayat //
14.d:
बहून् हत्वा नरादींश् च भीमसेनमथाब्रवीत् /
गदया प्रहरन्तं तु भीमस्तन्तु व्यपातयत् //
14.m: Having slain many men and others, he then spoke to Bhīmasena; / but as he struck with his club, Bhīma struck him down.

14.s:
gadayānyānujāṃstasya tasminnaṣṭādeśehani /
rātrau suṣuptañca balaṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ nyapātayat //
14.d:
गदयान्यानुजांस्तस्य तस्मिन्नष्टादेशेहनि /
रात्रौ सुषुप्तञ्च बलं पाण्डवानां न्यपातयत् //
14.m: [He killed] his other younger brothers with the club on that eighteenth day. / At night, the sleeping army of the Pāṇḍavas was struck down

14.s:
akṣauhiṇīpramāṇantu aśvatthāmā mahābalaḥ /
draupadeyān sapāñcālān dhṛṣṭadyumnañca so 'badhīt //
14.d:
अक्षौहिणीप्रमाणन्तु अश्वत्थामा महाबलः /
द्रौपदेयान् सपाञ्चालान् धृष्टद्युम्नञ्च सो ऽबधीत् //
14.m: to the measure of an akṣauhiṇī by the mighty Aśvatthāman; / he killed the sons of Draupadī, along with the Pāñcālas and Dhṛṣṭadyumna.

14.s:
putrahīnāṃ draupadīṃ tāṃ rudantīmarjunastataḥ /
śiromaṇiṃ tu jagrāha aiṣikāstreṇa tasya ca //
14.d:
पुत्रहीनां द्रौपदीं तां रुदन्तीमर्जुनस्ततः /
शिरोमणिं तु जग्राह ऐषिकास्त्रेण तस्य च //
14.m: Then Arjuna, [seeing] that Draupadī weeping, bereft of her sons, / seized his crest-jewel with the reed-missile.

14.s:
aśvatthāmāstranirdagdhaṃ jīvayāmāsa vai hariḥ /
uttarāyāstato garbhaṃ sa parīkṣidabhūnnṛpaḥ //
14.d:
अश्वत्थामास्त्रनिर्दग्धं जीवयामास वै हरिः /
उत्तरायास्ततो गर्भं स परीक्षिदभून्नृपः //
14.m: Hari revived the embryo in Uttarā's womb / that had been scorched by Aśvatthāman's weapon; that [child] became King Parīkṣit.

14.s:
kṛtavarmā kṛpo drauṇistrayo muktāstato raṇāt /
pāṇḍavāḥ sātyakiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sapta muktā na cāpare //
14.d:
कृतवर्मा कृपो द्रौणिस्त्रयो मुक्तास्ततो रणात् /
पाण्डवाः सात्यकिः कृष्णः सप्त मुक्ता न चापरे //
14.m: Kṛtavarman, Kṛpa, and the son of Droṇa—three survived that battle; / the Pāṇḍavas, Sātyaki, and Kṛṣṇa—seven survived, and no others.

14.s:
striyaścārtāḥ samāśvāsya bhīmādyaiḥ sa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ /
saṃskṛtya prahatān vīrān dattodakadhanādikaḥ //
14.d:
स्त्रियश्चार्ताः समाश्वास्य भीमाद्यैः स युधिष्ठिरः /
संस्कृत्य प्रहतान् वीरान् दत्तोदकधनादिकः //
14.m: Yudhiṣṭhira, having consoled the grieving women along with Bhīma and the others, / performed the funeral rites for the slain heroes, offering water, wealth, and the like.

14.s:
bhīṣmācchāntanavācchrutvā dharmān sarvāṃś ca śāntidām /
rājadharmānmokṣadharmāndānadharmān nṛpo 'bhavat //
14.d:
भीष्माच्छान्तनवाच्छ्रुत्वा धर्मान् सर्वांश् च शान्तिदाम् /
राजधर्मान्मोक्षधर्मान्दानधर्मान् नृपो ऽभवत् //
14.m: Having heard from Bhīṣma, son of Śāntanu, all the peace-giving duties— / the duties of kings, the duties of liberation, and the duties of giving—he became king.

14.s:
aśvamedhe dadau dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyorimardanaḥ /
:p 37
śrutvārjunānmauṣaleyaṃ(1) yādavānāñca saṅkṣayam /
rājye parīkṣitaṃ sthāpya sānujaḥ svargamāptavān (2) //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye mahābhāratavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
pāṇḍavacaritavarṇanam
14.d:
अश्वमेधे ददौ दानं ब्राह्मणेभ्योरिमर्दनः /
:प् 37
श्रुत्वार्जुनान्मौषलेयं(1) यादवानाञ्च सङ्क्षयम् /
राज्ये परीक्षितं स्थाप्य सानुजः स्वर्गमाप्तवान् (2) //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये महाभारतवर्णनं नाम चतुर्दशो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ पञ्चदशो ऽध्यायः
पाण्डवचरितवर्णनम्
14.m:
In the horse sacrifice, the crusher of enemies gave gifts to the brāhmaṇas.
:p 37
Having heard from Arjuna of the iron-club catastrophe and the destruction of the Yādavas,
he installed Parīkṣit on the throne and, accompanied by his younger brothers, attained heaven.
Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, named “The Description of the Mahābhārata,” in the Ādi-Mahāpurāṇa of Agni.
Now begins the fifteenth chapter.
Description of the Deeds of the Pāṇḍavas

15.s:
agnir uvāca
yudhiṣṭhire tu rājyasthe āśramādāśramāntaram /
dhṛtarāṣṭro vanamagād gāndhārī ca pṛthā dvija //
15.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
युधिष्ठिरे तु राज्यस्थे आश्रमादाश्रमान्तरम् /
धृतराष्ट्रो वनमगाद् गान्धारी च पृथा द्विज //
15.m: Agni said: / While Yudhiṣṭhira was on the throne, Dhṛtarāṣṭra went from stage of life to stage of life, / going to the forest, and [so did] Gāndhārī and Pṛthā, O twice-born.

15.s:
vidurastvagninā dagdho vanajena divaṅgataḥ /
evaṃ viṣṇurbhuvo bhāramaharaddānavādikam //
15.d:
विदुरस्त्वग्निना दग्धो वनजेन दिवङ्गतः /
एवं विष्णुर्भुवो भारमहरद्दानवादिकम् //
15.m: Vidura, consumed by a forest fire, went to heaven. / In this way Viṣṇu lifted the burden of the earth consisting of the Dānavas and others,

15.s:
dharmāyādharmanāśāya nimittīkṛtya pāṇḍavān /
sa vipraśāpavyājena muṣalenāharat kulam //
15.d:
धर्मायाधर्मनाशाय निमित्तीकृत्य पाण्डवान् /
स विप्रशापव्याजेन मुषलेनाहरत् कुलम् //
15.m: using the Pāṇḍavas as his instrument for the sake of righteousness and the destruction of unrighteousness. / Under the pretext of a brāhmaṇa's curse, he destroyed the lineage with an iron club.

15.s:
yādavānāṃ bhārakaraṃ vajraṃ rājyebhyaṣecayat /
devadeśāt prabhāse sa dehaṃ tyaktvā svayaṃ hariḥ //
15.d:
यादवानां भारकरं वज्रं राज्येभ्यषेचयत् /
देवदेशात् प्रभासे स देहं त्यक्त्वा स्वयं हरिः //
15.m: He consecrated Vajra to the kingdom, [the Yādavas] having become a burden. / At Prabhāsa, leaving the land of the gods, Hari himself discarded his body.

15.s:
indraloke brahmaloke pūjyate svargavāsibhiḥ /
balabhadronantamūrtiḥ pātālasvargamīyivān //
15.d:
इन्द्रलोके ब्रह्मलोके पूज्यते स्वर्गवासिभिः /
बलभद्रोनन्तमूर्तिः पातालस्वर्गमीयिवान् //
15.m: He is worshipped by the dwellers of heaven in the realm of Indra and the realm of Brahmā. / Balabhadra, of infinite form, went to the subterranean realm and heaven.

15.s:
avināśī harirdevo dhyānibhirdhyeya eva saḥ /
vinā taṃ dvārakāsthānaṃ plāvayāmāsa sāgaraḥ //
15.d:
अविनाशी हरिर्देवो ध्यानिभिर्ध्येय एव सः /
विना तं द्वारकास्थानं प्लावयामास सागरः //
15.m: Hari, the Lord, is imperishable; he is indeed to be meditated upon by meditators. / Without him, the ocean submerged the site of Dvārakā.

15.s:
saṃskṛtya yādavān pārtho dattodakadhanādikaḥ /
striyoṣṭāvakraśāpena bhāryā viṣṇoś ca yāḥ sthitāḥ //
15.d:
संस्कृत्य यादवान् पार्थो दत्तोदकधनादिकः /
स्त्रियोष्टावक्रशापेन भार्या विष्णोश् च याः स्थिताः //
15.m: Pārtha, having performed the funeral rites for the Yādavas, offering water, wealth, and the like— / the women, wives of Viṣṇu who remained, due to the curse of Aṣṭāvakra,

15.s:
punastacchāpato nītā gopālair laguḍāyudhaiḥ /
arjunaṃ hi tiraskṛtya pārthaḥ śokañcakāra ha //
15.d:
पुनस्तच्छापतो नीता गोपालैर् लगुडायुधैः /
अर्जुनं हि तिरस्कृत्य पार्थः शोकञ्चकार ह //
15.m: were again carried off due to that curse by cowherds armed with clubs. / Disregarding Arjuna, they did so, and Pārtha grieved.

15.s:
vyāsenāśvāsito mene balaṃ me kṛṣṇasannidhau /
:n
1 mauṣaleneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 svargamāpnuyāditi kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 38
hastināpuramāgatya pārthaḥ sarvaṃ nyavedayat //
15.d:
व्यासेनाश्वासितो मेने बलं मे कृष्णसन्निधौ /
:न्
1 मौषलेनेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्वर्गमाप्नुयादिति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 38
हस्तिनापुरमागत्य पार्थः सर्वं न्यवेदयत् //
15.m:
Consoled by Vyāsa, he thought: “My strength was [only] in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.”
:n
1 The reading in the manuscript marked kha is mauṣalena.
2 The reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga is svargamāpnuyāt.
:p 38
Having arrived at Hastināpura, Pārtha reported everything

15.s:
yudhiṣṭhirāya sa bhrātre pālakāya nṛṇāntadā /
taddhanustāni cāstrāṇi sa rathaste ca vājinaḥ //
15.d:
युधिष्ठिराय स भ्रात्रे पालकाय नृणान्तदा /
तद्धनुस्तानि चास्त्राणि स रथस्ते च वाजिनः //
15.m: to his brother Yudhiṣṭhira, the protector of men at that time. / That bow, those missiles, that chariot, and those horses—

15.s:
vinā kṛṣṇena tannaṣṭaṃ dānañcāśrotriye yathā /
tac chrutvā dharmarājastu rājye sthāpya parīkṣitam //
15.d:
विना कृष्णेन तन्नष्टं दानञ्चाश्रोत्रिये यथा /
तच् छ्रुत्वा धर्मराजस्तु राज्ये स्थाप्य परीक्षितम् //
15.m: without Kṛṣṇa, all that was lost, like a gift given to one not learned in the Veda. / Hearing that, the King of Righteousness installed Parīkṣit on the throne,

15.s:
prasthānaṃ prasthito dhīmān draupadyā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha /
saṃsārānityatāṃ jñātvā japannaṣṭaśataṃ hareḥ //
15.d:
प्रस्थानं प्रस्थितो धीमान् द्रौपद्या भ्रातृभिः सह /
संसारानित्यतां ज्ञात्वा जपन्नष्टशतं हरेः //
15.m: and the wise king set out on the great journey together with Draupadī and his brothers, / knowing the transience of the cycle of existence, reciting the hundred and eight [names] of Hari.

15.s:
mahāpathe tu patitā draupadī sahadevakaḥ /
nakulaḥ phālguno bhīmo rājā śokaparāyaṇaḥ //
15.d:
महापथे तु पतिता द्रौपदी सहदेवकः /
नकुलः फाल्गुनो भीमो राजा शोकपरायणः //
15.m: On the great path fell Draupadī, Sahadeva, / Nakula, Phālguna, and Bhīma; the king was dedicated to sorrow.

15.s:
indrānītarathārūḍhaḥ sānujaḥ svargamāptavān /
dṛṣṭvā duryodhanādīṃś ca vāsudevaṃ ca harṣitaḥ //
etatte bhārataṃ proktaṃ yaḥ paṭhetsa divaṃ vrajet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye mahābhāratavarṇanaṃ nāma
pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
buddhādyavatārakathanam
15.d:
इन्द्रानीतरथारूढः सानुजः स्वर्गमाप्तवान् /
दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनादींश् च वासुदेवं च हर्षितः //
एतत्ते भारतं प्रोक्तं यः पठेत्स दिवं व्रजेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये महाभारतवर्णनं नाम
पञ्चदशो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ षोडशो ऽध्यायः
बुद्धाद्यवतारकथनम्
15.m:
Mounted on the chariot brought by Indra, he attained heaven along with his younger brothers. / Seeing Duryodhana and the others, and Vāsudeva, he was overjoyed. / This Mahābhārata has been related to you; whoever recites it shall go to heaven.
Thus ends the fifteenth chapter, named “The Description of the Mahābhārata,” in the Ādi-Mahāpurāṇa of Agni.
Now begins the sixteenth chapter.
Narration of the Buddha and Other Incarnations

16.s:
agnir uvāca
vakṣye buddhāvatārañca paṭhataḥ śṛṇvatorthadam /
purā devāsure yuddhe daityair devāḥ parājitāḥ //
16.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
वक्ष्ये बुद्धावतारञ्च पठतः शृण्वतोर्थदम् /
पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे दैत्यैर् देवाः पराजिताः //
16.m: Agni said: / I shall declare the Buddha incarnation, which bestows welfare upon those who recite and hear it. / Formerly, in the war between the gods and asuras, the gods were defeated by the daityas.

16.s:
rakṣa rakṣeti śaraṇaṃ vadanto jagmurīśvaram /
māyamohasvaruposau śuddhodanasuto 'bhavat //
16.d:
रक्ष रक्षेति शरणं वदन्तो जग्मुरीश्वरम् /
मायमोहस्वरुपोसौ शुद्धोदनसुतो ऽभवत् //
16.m: Crying, “Protect us, protect us!” they went to the Lord for refuge. / He, taking the form of illusory delusion, became the son of Śuddhodana.

16.s:
mohayāmāsa daityāṃstāṃstyājitā vedadharmakam /
te ca bauddhā babhūvurhi tebhyonye vedavarjitāḥ //
16.d:
मोहयामास दैत्यांस्तांस्त्याजिता वेदधर्मकम् /
ते च बौद्धा बभूवुर्हि तेभ्योन्ये वेदवर्जिताः //
16.m: He deluded those daityas and caused them to abandon the religion of the Veda; / and they became Buddhists, and from them others became devoid of the Veda.

16.s:
ārhataḥ so 'bhavat paścādārhatānakarot parān /
evaṃ pāṣaṇḍino jātā vedadharmādivarjitāḥ //
:p 39
16.d:
आर्हतः सो ऽभवत् पश्चादार्हतानकरोत् परान् /
एवं पाषण्डिनो जाता वेदधर्मादिवर्जिताः //
:प् 39
16.m:
He then became a Jaina, and made others into Jainas; / thus heretics were born, devoid of the religion of the Veda and the like.
:p 39

16.s:
narakārhaṃ karma cakrurgrahīṣyantyadhamādapi /
sarve kaliyugānte tu bhaviṣyanti ca saṅkarāḥ //
16.d:
नरकार्हं कर्म चक्रुर्ग्रहीष्यन्त्यधमादपि /
सर्वे कलियुगान्ते तु भविष्यन्ति च सङ्कराः //
16.m: They performed actions deserving of hell, and will receive [alms] even from the degraded; / and at the end of the Kali age, all will become of mixed caste.

16.s:
dasyavaḥ śīlahīnāś ca vedo vājasaneyakaḥ /
daśa pañca ca śākhā vai pramāṇena bhaviṣyati //
16.d:
दस्यवः शीलहीनाश् च वेदो वाजसनेयकः /
दश पञ्च च शाखा वै प्रमाणेन भविष्यति //
16.m: Robbers and devoid of virtuous conduct, the Veda will be the Vājasaneyaka, / and will indeed exist in fifteen recensions by standard.

16.s:
dharmakañcukasaṃvītā adharmarucayas tathā /
mānuṣān bhakṣayiṣyanti mlecchāḥ pārthivarūpiṇaḥ //
16.d:
धर्मकञ्चुकसंवीता अधर्मरुचयस् तथा /
मानुषान् भक्षयिष्यन्ति म्लेच्छाः पार्थिवरूपिणः //
16.m: Clothed in the cloak of righteousness, yet delighting in unrighteousness, / mlecchas disguised as kings will devour human beings.

16.s:
kalkī viṣṇuyaśaḥputro yājñavalkyapurohitaḥ /
utsādayiṣyati mlecchān gṛhītāstraḥ kṛtāyudhaḥ //
16.d:
कल्की विष्णुयशःपुत्रो याज्ञवल्क्यपुरोहितः /
उत्सादयिष्यति म्लेच्छान् गृहीतास्त्रः कृतायुधः //
16.m: Kalkī, the son of Viṣṇuyaśas, having Yājñavalkya as his family priest, / will destroy the mlecchas, bearing missiles and armed with weapons.

16.s:
sthāpayiṣyati maryādāṃ cāturvarṇye yathocitām /
āśrameṣu ca sarveṣu prajāḥ saddharmavartmani //
16.d:
स्थापयिष्यति मर्यादां चातुर्वर्ण्ये यथोचिताम् /
आश्रमेषु च सर्वेषु प्रजाः सद्धर्मवर्त्मनि //
16.m: He will establish the proper order for the four castes / and in all stages of life, [settling] the subjects on the path of true righteousness.

16.s:
kalkirūpaṃ parityajya hariḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyati /
tataḥ kṛtayugānnāma purāvat sambhaviṣyati //
16.d:
कल्किरूपं परित्यज्य हरिः स्वर्गं गमिष्यति /
ततः कृतयुगान्नाम पुरावत् सम्भविष्यति //
16.m:
Abandoning the form of Kalki, Hari will go to heaven;
then the period named the Kṛta Yuga will come to be as before.

16.s:
varnāśramāś ca dharmeṣu sveṣu sthāsyanti sattama /
evaṃ sarveṣu kalpeṣu sarvamanvantareṣu ca //
16.d:
वर्नाश्रमाश् च धर्मेषु स्वेषु स्थास्यन्ति सत्तम /
एवं सर्वेषु कल्पेषु सर्वमन्वन्तरेषु च //
16.m:
